analyzed: snātaka vrata kalpaḥ ca sattva vṛddhi karaḥ śubhaḥ

original: Manu4.260a[261ṃa]/ anena vipro vṛttena vartayan) veda.śāstravit |
analyzed: anena vipraḥ vṛttena vartayan veda śāstra vid

original: Manu4.260c[261ṃc]/ vyapeta.kalmaṣo nityaṃ brahmaloke mahīyate) ||
analyzed: vyapeta kalmaṣaḥ nityam brahma loke mahīyate

original: Manu5.01a/ śrutvā-etān ṛṣayo dharmān snātakasya yathā.uditān |
analyzed: śrutvā etān ṛṣayaḥ dharmān snātakasya yathā uditān

original: Manu5.01c/ idam ūcur mahātmānam anala.prabhavaṃ bhṛgum ||
analyzed: idam ūcuḥ mahātmānam anala prabhavam bhṛgum

original: Manu5.02a/ evaṃ yathā.uktaṃ viprāṇāṃ svadharmam anutiṣṭhatām |
analyzed: evam yathā uktam viprāṇām svadharmam anutiṣṭhatām

original: Manu5.02c/ kathaṃ mṛtyuḥ prabhavati veda.śāstravidāṃ prabho ||
analyzed: katham mṛtyuḥ prabhavati veda śāstra vidām prabho

original: Manu5.03a/ sa tān uvāca dharma.ātmā maharṣīn mānavo bhṛguḥ |
analyzed: sa tān uvāca dharma ātmā mahā ṛṣīn mānavaḥ bhṛguḥ

original: Manu5.03c/ śrūyatāṃ yena doṣeṇa mṛtyur viprān jighāṃsati ||
analyzed: śrūyatām yena doṣeṇa mṛtyuḥ viprān jighāṃsati

original: Manu5.04a/ anabhyāsena vedānām ācārasya ca varjanāt |
analyzed: anabhyāsena vedānām ācārasya ca varjanāt

original: Manu5.04c/ ālasyād annadoṣāc ca mṛtyur viprāñ jighāṃsati ||[M.viprān]
analyzed: ālasyāt anna doṣāt ca mṛtyuḥ viprān jighāṃsati

original: Manu5.05a/ laśunaṃ gṛñjanaṃ ca-eva palāṇḍuṃ kavakāni ca |
analyzed: laśunam gṛñjanam ca eva palāṇḍum kavakāni ca

original: Manu5.05c/ abhakṣyāṇi dvijātīnām amedhya.prabhavāni ca ||
analyzed: abhakṣyāṇi dvijātīnām amedhya prabhavāni ca

original: Manu5.06a/ lohitān vṛkṣaniryāsān vṛścana.prabhavāṃs tathā | [M.vraścana.prabhavāṃs ]
analyzed: lohitān vṛkṣa niryāsān vṛścana prabhavān tathā

original: Manu5.06c/ śeluṃ gavyaṃ ca peyūṣaṃ prayatnena vivarjayet || [M.pīyūṣaṃ ]
analyzed: śelum gavyam ca peyūṣam prayatnena vivarjayet

original: Manu5.07a/ vṛthā kṛsara.saṃyāvaṃ pāyasa.apūpam eva ca |
analyzed: vṛthā kṛsara saṃyāvam pāyasa apūpam eva ca

original: Manu5.07c/ an.upākṛtamāṃsāni devānnāni havīṃṣi ca ||
analyzed: an upākṛta māṃsāni deva annāni havīṃṣi ca

original: Manu5.08a/ a.nirdaśāyā goḥ kṣīram auṣṭram aikaśaphaṃ tathā |
analyzed: anirdaśāyāḥ goḥ kṣīram auṣṭram aikaśapham tathā

original: Manu5.08c/ āvikaṃ saṃdhinīkṣīraṃ vi.vatsāyāś ca goḥ payaḥ ||[M.sandhinīkṣīraṃ]
analyzed: āvikam saṃdhinī kṣīram vivatsāyāḥ ca goḥ payaḥ

original: Manu5.09a/ āraṇyānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ mṛgāṇāṃ māhiṣaṃ vinā |
analyzed: āraṇyānām ca sarveṣām mṛgāṇām māhiṣam vinā

original: Manu5.09c/ strīkṣīraṃ ca-eva varjyāni sarvaśuktāni ca-eva hi ||
analyzed: strī kṣīram ca eva varjyāni sarva śuktāni ca eva hi

original: Manu5.10a/ dadhi bhakṣyaṃ ca śukteṣu sarvaṃ ca dadhi.saṃbhavam | [M.dadhi.saṃbhavam]
analyzed: dadhi bhakṣyam ca śukteṣu sarvam ca dadhi saṃbhavam

original: Manu5.10c/ yāni ca-eva-abhiṣūyante puṣpa.mūla.phalaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
analyzed: yāni ca eva abhiṣūyante puṣpa mūla phalaiḥ śubhaiḥ

original: Manu5.11a/ kravyādāñ śakunān sarvān- tathā grāmanivāsinaḥ |  [M.kravyādaḥ śakunīn]
analyzed: kravyādān śakunān sarvān tathā grāma nivāsinaḥ

original: Manu5.11c/ a.nirdiṣṭāṃś ca-ekaśaphāṃṣ ṭiṭṭibhaṃ ca vivarjayet ||
analyzed: a nirdiṣṭān ca ekaśaphān ṭiṭṭibham ca vivarjayet

original: Manu5.12a/ kalaviṅkaṃ plavaṃ haṃsaṃ cakrāhvaṃ grāmakukkuṭam |
analyzed: kalaviṅkam plavam haṃsam cakrāhvam grāma kukkuṭam

original: Manu5.12c/ sārasaṃ rajjuvālaṃ ca dātyūhaṃ śuka.sārike || [M.rajjudālaṃ]
analyzed: sārasam rajjuvālam ca dātyūham śuka sārike

original: Manu5.13a/ pratudāñ jālapādāṃś ca koyaṣṭi.nakhaviṣkirān | [M.pratudān]
analyzed: pratudān jālapādān ca koyaṣṭi nakhaviṣkirān

original: Manu5.13c/ nimajjataś ca matsyādān saunaṃ vallūram eva ca ||
analyzed: nimajjataḥ ca matsya ādān saunam vallūram eva ca

original: Manu5.14a/ bakaṃ ca-eva balākāṃ ca kākolaṃ khañjarīṭakam |
analyzed: bakam ca eva balākām ca kākolam khañjarīṭakam

original: Manu5.14c/ matsyādān viḍvarāhāṃś ca matsyān eva ca sarvaśaḥ ||
analyzed: matsya ādān viḍvarāhān ca matsyān eva ca sarvaśas

original: Manu5.15a/ yo yasya māṃsam aśnāti sa tanmāṃsāda ucyate |
analyzed: yaḥ yasya māṃsam aśnāti sa tad māṃsa ādaḥ ucyate

original: Manu5.15c/ matsyādaḥ sarvamāṃsādas tasmān matsyān vivarjayet ||
analyzed: matsya ādaḥ sarva māṃsa ādaḥ tasmāt matsyān vivarjayet

original: Manu5.16a/ pāṭhīna.rohitāv ādyau niyuktau havya.kavyayoḥ |
analyzed: pāṭhīna rohitau ādyau niyuktau havya kavyayoḥ

original: Manu5.16c/ rājīvān siṃhatuṇḍāś ca sa.śalkāś ca-eva sarvaśaḥ || [M.rājīvāḥ ]
analyzed: rājīvān siṃhatuṇḍāḥ ca sa śalkāḥ ca eva sarvaśas

original: Manu5.17a/ na bhakṣayed ekacarān ajñātāṃś ca mṛga.dvijān |
analyzed: na bhakṣayet ekacarān ajñātān ca mṛga dvijān

original: Manu5.17c/ bhakṣyeṣv api samuddiṣṭān sarvān pañcanakhāṃs tathā ||
analyzed: bhakṣyeṣu api samuddiṣṭān sarvān pañcanakhān tathā

original: Manu5.18a/ śvāvidhaṃ śalyakaṃ godhāṃ khaḍga.kūrma.śaśāṃs tathā |
analyzed: śvāvidham śalyakam godhām khaḍga kūrma śaśān tathā

original: Manu5.18c/ bhakṣyān pañcanakheṣv āhur anuṣṭrāṃś ca-ekatodatah ||
analyzed: bhakṣyān pañcanakheṣu āhuḥ an uṣṭrān

original: Manu5.19a/ chatrākaṃ viḍvarāhaṃ ca laśunaṃ grāmakukkuṭam |
analyzed: chatrākam viḍvarāham ca laśunam grāma kukkuṭam

original: Manu5.19c/ palāṇḍuṃ gṛñjanaṃ ca-eva matyā jagdhvā pated dvijaḥ ||
analyzed: palāṇḍum gṛñjanam ca eva matyā jagdhvā patet dvijaḥ

original: Manu5.20a/ a.matyā-etāni ṣaḍ jagdhvā kṛcchraṃ sāntapanaṃ caret |
analyzed: amatyā etāni ṣaḍ jagdhvā kṛcchram sāntapanam caret

original: Manu5.20c/ yaticāndrāyāṇaṃ vā-api śeṣeṣu-upavased ahaḥ ||
analyzed: yaticāndrāyāṇam vā api śeṣeṣu upavaset ahar

original: Manu5.21a/ saṃvatsarasya-ekam api caret kṛcchraṃ dvijottamaḥ |
analyzed: saṃvatsarasya ekam api caret kṛcchram dvijottamaḥ

original: Manu5.21c/ a.jñātabhuktaśuddhi.arthaṃ jñātasya tu viṣeśataḥ ||
analyzed: ajñāta bhukta śuddhi artham jñātasya tu viṣa īśataḥ

original: Manu5.22a/ yajñārthaṃ brāhmaṇair vadhyāḥ praśastā mṛga.pakṣiṇaḥ |
analyzed: yajña artham brāhmaṇaiḥ vadhyāḥ praśastāḥ mṛga pakṣiṇaḥ

original: Manu5.22c/ bhṛtyānāṃ ca-eva vṛtti.artham agastyo hy ācarat purā ||
analyzed: bhṛtyānām ca eva vṛtti artham agastyaḥ hi ācarat purā

original: Manu5.23a/ babhūvur hi puroḍāśā bhakṣyāṇāṃ mṛga.pakṣiṇām |
analyzed: babhūvuḥ hi puroḍāśāḥ bhakṣyāṇām mṛga pakṣiṇām

original: Manu5.23c/ purāṇeṣv api yajñeṣu brahma.kṣatrasaveṣu ca || [[M.purāṇeṣv ṛṣiyajñeṣu]
analyzed: purāṇeṣu api yajñeṣu brahma kṣatra saveṣu ca purāṇeṣu ṛṣi yajñeṣu

original: Manu5.24a/ yat kiṃ cit snehasaṃyuktaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhojyam a.garhitam |
analyzed: yat kim cit sneha saṃyuktam bhakṣyam bhojyam agarhitam

original: Manu5.24c/ tat paryuṣitam apy ādyaṃ haviḥśeṣaṃ ca yad bhavet ||
analyzed: tat paryuṣitam api ādyam haviḥ śeṣam ca yat bhavet

original: Manu5.25a/ cirasthitam api tv ādyam a.snehāktaṃ dvijātibhiḥ |
analyzed: cira sthitam api tu ādyam asneha aktam dvijātibhiḥ

original: Manu5.25c/ yava.godhūmajaṃ sarvaṃ payasaś ca-eva vikriyā ||
analyzed: yava godhūma jam sarvam payasaḥ ca eva vikriyā

original: Manu5.26a/ etad uktaṃ dvijātīnāṃ bhakṣya.abhakṣyam a.śeṣataḥ |
analyzed: etat uktam dvijātīnām bhakṣya abhakṣyam aśeṣatas

original: Manu5.26c/ māṃsasya-ataḥ pravakṣyāmi vidhiṃ bhakṣaṇavarjane ||
analyzed: māṃsasya atas pravakṣyāmi vidhim bhakṣaṇa varjane

original: Manu5.27a/ prokṣitaṃ bhakṣayen māṃsaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca kāmyayā |
analyzed: prokṣitam bhakṣayet māṃsam brāhmaṇānām ca kāmyayā

original: Manu5.27c/ yathāvidhi niyuktas tu prāṇānām eva ca-atyaye ||
analyzed: yathāvidhi niyuktaḥ tu prāṇānām eva ca atyaye

original: Manu5.28a/ prāṇasya-annam idaṃ sarvaṃ prajāpatir akalpayat |
analyzed: prāṇasya annam idam sarvam prajāpatiḥ akalpayat

original: Manu5.28c/ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca-eva sarvaṃ prāṇasya bhojanam ||
analyzed: sthāvaram jaṅgamam ca eva sarvam prāṇasya bhojanam

original: Manu5.29a/ carāṇām annam a.carā daṃṣṭriṇām apy a.daṃṣṭriṇaḥ |
analyzed: carāṇām annam acarāḥ daṃṣṭriṇām api adaṃṣṭriṇaḥ

original: Manu5.29c/ a.hastāś ca sa.hastānāṃ śūrāṇāṃ ca-eva bhīravaḥ ||
analyzed: ahastāḥ ca sa hastānām śūrāṇām ca eva bhīravaḥ

original: Manu5.30a/ na-attā duṣyaty adann ādyān prāṇino 'ahany.ahany api |
analyzed: na attā duṣyati adan ādyān prāṇinaḥ ahani ahani api

original: Manu5.30c/ dhātrā-eva sṛṣṭā hy ādyāś ca prāṇino 'attāra eva ca ||
analyzed: dhātrā eva sṛṣṭāḥ hi ādyāḥ ca prāṇinaḥ attāraḥ eva ca

original: Manu5.31a/ yajñāya jagdhir māṃsasya-ity eṣa daivo vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
analyzed: yajñāya jagdhiḥ māṃsasya eti eṣa daivaḥ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ

original: Manu5.31c/ ato 'anyathā pravṛttis tu rākṣaso vidhir ucyate ||
analyzed: atas anyathā pravṛttiḥ tu rākṣasaḥ vidhiḥ ucyate

original: Manu5.32a/ krītvā svayaṃ vā-apy utpādya para.upakṛtam eva vā |
analyzed: krītvā svayam utpādya para aupakṛtam eva vā

original: Manu5.32c/ devān pitqṃś ca-arcayitvā khādan māṃsaṃ na duṣyati ||
analyzed: devān pitqn ca arcayitvā khādat māṃsam na duṣyati

original: Manu5.33a/ na-adyād avidhinā māṃsaṃ vidhijño 'anāpadi dvijaḥ |
analyzed: na adyāt avidhinā māṃsam vidhi jñaḥ anāpadi dvijaḥ

original: Manu5.33c/ jagdhvā hy a.vidhinā māṃsaṃ pretas tair adyate 'a.vaśaḥ ||
analyzed: jagdhvā hi avidhinā māṃsam pretaḥ taiḥ adyate avaśaḥ

original: Manu5.34a/ na tādṛśaṃ bhavaty eno mṛgahantur dhanārthinaḥ |
analyzed: na tādṛśam bhavati enaḥ mṛga hantuḥ dhana arthinaḥ

original: Manu5.34c/ yādṛśaṃ bhavati pretya vṛthāmāṃsāni khādataḥ ||
analyzed: yādṛśam bhavati pretya vṛthāmāṃsāni khādataḥ

original: Manu5.35a/ niyuktas tu yathānyāyaṃ yo māṃsaṃ na-atti mānavaḥ |
analyzed: niyuktaḥ tu yathānyāyam yaḥ māṃsam naatti mānavaḥ

original: Manu5.35c/ sa pretya paśutāṃ yāti saṃbhavān ekaviṃśatim ||
analyzed: sa pretya paśu tām yāti saṃbhavān ekaviṃśatim

original: Manu5.36a/ asaṃskṛtān paśūn mantrair na-adyād vipraḥ kadā cana |
analyzed: a saṃskṛtān paśūn mantraiḥ na adyāt vipraḥ kadā cana

original: Manu5.36c/ mantrais tu saṃskṛtān adyāt-śāśvataṃ vidhim āsthitaḥ ||
analyzed: mantraiḥ tu saṃskṛtān adyāt śāśvatam vidhim āsthitaḥ

original: Manu5.37a/ kuryād ghṛtapaśuṃ saṅge kuryāt piṣṭapaśuṃ tathā |
analyzed: kuryāt ghṛtapaśum saṅge kuryāt piṣṭapaśum tathā

original: Manu5.37c/ na tv eva tu vṛthā hantuṃ paśum icchet kadā cana ||
analyzed: na tu eva tu vṛthak hantum paśum icchet kadā cana

original: Manu5.38a/ yāvanti paśuromāṇi tāvatkṛtvo ha māraṇam |
analyzed: yāvanti paśu romāṇi tāvat kṛtvas ha māraṇam

original: Manu5.38c/ vṛthāpaśughnaḥ prāpnoti pretya janmani janmani ||
analyzed: vṛthak paśu ghnaḥ prāpnoti pretya janmani janmani

original: Manu5.39a/ yajñārthaṃ paśavaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayam eva svayaṃbhuvā |
analyzed: yajña artham paśavaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayam eva svayaṃbhuvā

original: Manu5.39c/ yajño 'asya bhūtyai sarvasya tasmād yajñe vadho 'a.vadhaḥ ||
analyzed: yajñaḥ asya bhūtyai sarvasya tasmāt yajñe vadhaḥ a vadhaḥ

original: Manu5.40a/ oṣadhyaḥ paśavo vṛkṣās tiryañcaḥ pakṣiṇas tathā |
analyzed: oṣadhyaḥ paśavaḥ vṛkṣāḥ tiryañcaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ tathā

original: Manu5.40c/ yajñārthaṃ nidhanaṃ prāptāḥ prāpnuvanty utsṛtīḥ  punaḥ || [M.ucchritīḥ]
analyzed: yajña artham nidhanam prāptāḥ prāpnuvanti utsṛtīḥ punar

original: Manu5.41a/ madhuparke ca yajñe ca pitṛ.daivatakarmaṇi |
analyzed: madhuparke ca yajñe ca pitṛ daivata karmaṇi

original: Manu5.41c/ atra-eva paśavo hiṃsyā na-anyatra-ity abravīn manuḥ ||
analyzed: atra eva paśavaḥ hiṃsyāḥ na anyatra eti abravīt manuḥ

original: Manu5.42a/ eṣv artheṣu paśūn hiṃsan vedatattvārthavid dvijaḥ |
analyzed: eṣu artheṣu paśūn hiṃsan veda tattva artha vid dvijaḥ

original: Manu5.42c/ ātmānaṃ ca paśuṃ ca-eva gamayaty uttamaṃ gatim ||
analyzed: ātmānam ca paśum ca eva gamayati uttamam gatim

original: Manu5.43a/ gṛhe gurāv araṇye vā nivasann ātmavān dvijaḥ |
analyzed: gṛhe gurau araṇye vā nivasan ātmavān dvijaḥ

original: Manu5.43c/ na-a.vedavihitāṃ hiṃsām āpady api samācaret ||
analyzed: na a veda vihitām hiṃsām āpadi api samācaret

original: Manu5.44a/ yā vedavihitā hiṃsā niyatā-asmiṃś cara.acare |
analyzed: yā veda vihitā hiṃsā niyatā asmin cara acare

original: Manu5.44c/ ahiṃsām eva tāṃ vidyād vedād dharmo hi nirbabhau ||
analyzed: ahiṃsām eva tām vidyāt vedāt dharmaḥ hi nirbabhau

original: Manu5.45a/ yo 'ahiṃsakāni bhūtāni hinasty ātmasukha.icchayā |
analyzed: yaḥ ahiṃsakāni bhūtāni hinasti ātma sukha ecchayā

original: Manu5.45c/ sa jīvāṃś ca mṛtaś ca-eva na kva cit sukham edhate ||
analyzed: sa jīvān ca mṛtaḥ ca eva na kva cit sukham edhate

original: Manu5.46a/ yo bandhanavadhakleśān prāṇināṃ na cikīrṣati |
analyzed: yaḥ bandhana vadha kleśān prāṇinām na cikīrṣati

original: Manu5.46c/ sa sarvasya hitaprepsuḥ sukham atyantam aśnute ||
analyzed: sa sarvasya hita prepsuḥ sukham atyantam aśnute

original: Manu5.47a/ yad dhyāyati yat kurute ratiṃ badhnāti yatra ca |
analyzed: yat dhyāyati yat kurute ratim badhnāti yatra ca

original: Manu5.47c/ tad avāpnoty ayatnena yo hinasti na kiṃ cana ||
analyzed: tat avāpnoti ayatnena yaḥ hinasti na kim cana

original: Manu5.48a/ na-a.kṛtvā prāṇināṃ hiṃsāṃ māṃsam utpadyate kva cit |
analyzed: na a kṛtvā prāṇinām hiṃsām māṃsam utpadyate kva cit

original: Manu5.48c/ na ca prāṇivadhaḥ svargyas tasmān māṃsaṃ vivarjayet ||
analyzed: na ca prāṇi vadhaḥ svargyaḥ tasmāt māṃsam vivarjayet

original: Manu5.49a/ samutpattiṃ ca māṃsasya vadha.bandhau ca dehinām |
analyzed: samutpattim ca māṃsasya vadha bandhau ca dehinām

original: Manu5.49c/ prasamīkṣya nivarteta sarvamāṃsasya bhakṣaṇāt ||
analyzed: prasamīkṣya nivarteta sarva māṃsasya bhakṣaṇāt

original: Manu5.50a/ na bhakṣayati yo māṃsaṃ vidhiṃ hitvā piśācavat |
analyzed: na bhakṣayati yaḥ māṃsam vidhim hitvā piśāca vat

original: Manu5.50c/ na loke priyatāṃ yāti vyādhibhiś ca na pīḍyate ||
analyzed: na loke priya tām yāti vyādhibhiḥ ca na pīḍyate

original: Manu5.51a/ anumantā viśasitā nihantā kraya.vikrayī |
analyzed: anumantā viśasitā nihantā kraya vikrayī

original: Manu5.51c/ saṃskartā ca-upahartā ca khādakaś ca-iti ghātakāḥ ||
analyzed: saṃskartā ca aupahartā ca khādakaḥ ca eti

original: Manu5.52a/ svamāṃsaṃ paramāṃsena yo vardhayitum icchati |
analyzed: sva māṃsam para māṃsena yaḥ vardhayitum icchati

original: Manu5.52c/ an.abhyarcya pitqn devāṃs tato 'anyo na-asty apuṇyakṛt ||
analyzed: an abhyarcya devān tatas anyaḥ na asti apuṇya kṛt

original: Manu5.53a/ varṣe varṣe 'aśvamedhena yo yajeta śataṃ samāḥ |

original: Manu6.95c/ niyato vedam abhyasya putraiśvarye sukhaṃ vaset ||

original: Manu6.96a/ evaṃ saṃnyasya karmāṇi svakārya.paramo 'a.spṛhaḥ |
analyzed: evam saṃnyasya karmāṇi sva kārya paramaḥ aspṛhaḥ

original: Manu6.96c/ saṃnyāsena-apahatya-enaḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ gatim ||
analyzed: saṃnyāsena apahatya enaḥ prāpnoti paramam gatim

original: Manu6.97a/ eṣa vo 'abhihito dharmo brāhmaṇasya catur.vidhaḥ |
analyzed: eṣa vaḥ abhihitaḥ dharmaḥ brāhmaṇasya caturvidhaḥ

original: Manu6.97c/ puṇyo 'akṣaya.phalaḥ pretya rājñāṃ dharmaṃ nibodhata ||
analyzed: puṇyaḥ akṣaya phalaḥ pretya rājñām dharmam nibodhata

original: Manu7.01a/ rājadharmān pravakṣyāmi yathāvṛtto bhaven nṛpaḥ |
analyzed: rāja dharmān pravakṣyāmi yathāvṛttaḥ bhavet nṛpaḥ

original: Manu7.01c/ saṃbhavaś ca yathā tasya siddhiś ca paramā yathā ||
analyzed: saṃbhavaḥ ca yathā tasya siddhiḥ ca paramā yathā

original: Manu7.02a/ brāhmaṃ prāptena saṃskāraṃ kṣatriyeṇa yathāvidhi |
analyzed: brāhmam prāptena saṃskāram kṣatriyeṇa yathāvidhi

original: Manu7.02c/ sarvasya-asya yathānyāyaṃ kartavyaṃ parirakṣaṇam ||
analyzed: sarvasya asya yathānyāyam kartavyam parirakṣaṇam

original: Manu7.03a/ a.rājake hi loke 'asmin sarvato vidruto bhayāt |
analyzed: arājake hi loke asmin sarvatas vidrutaḥ bhayāt

original: Manu7.03c/ rakṣārtham asya sarvasya rājānam asṛjat prabhuḥ ||
analyzed: rakṣā artham asya sarvasya rājānam asṛjat prabhuḥ

original: Manu7.04a/ indra.anila.yama.arkāṇām agneś ca varuṇasya ca |
analyzed: agneḥ ca varuṇasya ca

original: Manu7.04c/ candra.vitteśayoś ca-eva mātrā nirhṛtya śāśvatīḥ ||
analyzed: candra vitteśayoḥ ca eva mātrāḥ nirhṛtya śāśvatīḥ

original: Manu7.05a/ yasmād eṣāṃ surendrāṇāṃ mātrābhyo nirmito nṛpaḥ |
analyzed: yasmāt eṣām sura indrāṇām mātrābhyaḥ nirmitaḥ nṛpaḥ

original: Manu7.05c/ tasmād abhibhavaty eṣa sarvabhūtāni tejasā ||
analyzed: tasmāt abhibhavati eṣa sarva bhūtāni tejasā

original: Manu7.06a/ tapaty ādityavac ca-eṣa cakṣūṃṣi ca manāṃsi ca |
analyzed: tapati ādityavat ca eṣa cakṣūṃṣi ca manāṃsi ca

original: Manu7.06c/ na ca-enaṃ bhuvi śaknoti kaś cid apy abhivīkṣitum ||
analyzed: na ca enam bhuvi śaknoti kaḥ cit api abhivīkṣitum

original: Manu7.07a/ so 'agnir bhavati vāyuś ca so 'arkaḥ somaḥ sa dharmarāṭ |
analyzed: saḥ agniḥ bhavati vāyuḥ ca saḥ arkaḥ somaḥ sa dharmarāj

original: Manu7.07c/ sa kuberaḥ sa varuṇaḥ sa mahendraḥ prabhāvataḥ || [M.sa ca-indraḥ svaprabhāvataḥ] || [K: ]
analyzed: sa kuberaḥ sa varuṇaḥ sa mahendraḥ prabhāvataḥ

original: Manu7.08a/ bālo 'api na-avamāntavyo manuṣya iti bhūmipaḥ |
analyzed: bālaḥ api manuṣyaḥ iti bhūmipaḥ

original: Manu7.08c/ mahatī devatā hy eṣā nararūpeṇa tiṣṭhati ||
analyzed: mahatī devatā hi eṣā nara rūpeṇa tiṣṭhati

original: Manu7.09a/ ekam eva dahaty agnir naraṃ durupasarpiṇam |
analyzed: ekam eva dahati agniḥ naram durupasarpiṇam

original: Manu7.09c/ kulaṃ dahati rājā-agniḥ sa.paśu.dravyasaṃcayam ||
analyzed: kulam dahati rājā agniḥ sa paśu dravya saṃcayam

original: Manu7.10a/ kāryaṃ so 'avekṣya śaktiṃ ca deśa.kālau ca tattvataḥ |
analyzed: kāryam saḥ avekṣya śaktim ca deśa kālau ca tattvataḥ

original: Manu7.10c/ kurute dharmasiddhyarthaṃ viśvarūpaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||
analyzed: kurute dharma siddhi artham viśvarūpam punar punar

original: Manu7.11a/ yasya prasāde padmā śrīr vijayaś ca parākrame |
analyzed: yasya prasāde padmā śrīḥ vijayaḥ ca parākrame

original: Manu7.11c/ mṛtyuś ca vasati krodhe sarvatejomayo hi saḥ ||
analyzed: mṛtyuḥ ca vasati krodhe sarva tejaḥ mayaḥ hi saḥ

original: Manu7.12a/ taṃ yas tu dveṣṭi saṃmohāt sa vinaśyaty asaṃśayam |
analyzed: tam yaḥ tu dveṣṭi saṃmohāt sa vinaśyati asaṃśayam

original: Manu7.12c/ tasya hy āśu vināśāya rājā prakurute manaḥ ||
analyzed: tasya hi āśu vināśāya rājā prakurute manaḥ

original: Manu7.13a/ tasmād dharmaṃ yam iṣṭeṣu sa vyavasyen narādhipaḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt dharmam yam iṣṭeṣu sa vyavasyet narādhipaḥ

original: Manu7.13c/ aniṣṭaṃ ca-apy aniṣṭeṣu taṃ dharmaṃ na vicālayet ||
analyzed: aniṣṭam ca api aniṣṭeṣu tam dharmam na vicālayet

original: Manu7.14a/ tasyārthe sarvabhūtānāṃ goptāraṃ dharmam ātmajam | [M.tadarthaṃ]
analyzed: tasya arthe sarva bhūtānām goptāram dharmam ātmajam

original: Manu7.14c/ brahmatejomayaṃ daṇḍam asṛjat pūrvam īśvaraḥ ||
analyzed: brahma tejaḥ mayam daṇḍam asṛjat pūrvam īśvaraḥ

original: Manu7.15a/ tasya sarvāṇi bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca |
analyzed: tasya sarvāṇi bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca

original: Manu7.15c/ bhayād bhogāya kalpante svadharmāt-na calanti ca ||
analyzed: bhayāt bhogāya kalpante svadharmāt na calanti ca

original: Manu7.16a/ taṃ deśa.kālau śaktiṃ ca vidyāṃ ca-avekṣya tattvataḥ |
analyzed: tam deśa kālau śaktim ca vidyām ca avekṣya tattvataḥ

original: Manu7.16c/ yathārhataḥ saṃpraṇayen nareṣv anyāya.vartiṣu ||
analyzed: yathārhatas saṃpraṇayet nareṣu anyāya vartiṣu

original: Manu7.17a/ sa rājā puruṣo daṇḍaḥ sa netā śāsitā ca saḥ |
analyzed: sa rājā puruṣaḥ daṇḍaḥ sa netā śāsitā ca saḥ

original: Manu7.17c/ caturṇām āśramāṇāṃ ca dharmasya pratibhūḥ smṛtaḥ ||
analyzed: caturṇām āśramāṇām ca dharmasya pratibhūḥ smṛtaḥ

original: Manu7.18a/ daṇḍaḥ śāsti prajāḥ sarvā daṇḍa eva-abhirakṣati |
analyzed: daṇḍaḥ śāsti prajāḥ sarvāḥ daṇḍaḥ eva abhirakṣati

original: Manu7.18c/ daṇḍaḥ supteṣu jāgarti daṇḍaṃ dharmaṃ vidur budhāḥ ||
analyzed: daṇḍaḥ supteṣu jāgarti daṇḍam dharmam viduḥ budhāḥ

original: Manu7.19a/ samīkṣya sa dhṛtaḥ samyak sarvā rañjayati prajāḥ |
analyzed: samīkṣya sa dhṛtaḥ samyak sarvāḥ rañjayati prajāḥ

original: Manu7.19c/ a.samīkṣya praṇītas tu vināśayati sarvataḥ ||
analyzed: a samīkṣya praṇītaḥ tu vināśayati sarvatas

original: Manu7.20a/ yadi na praṇayed rājā daṇḍaṃ daṇḍyeṣv atandritaḥ |
analyzed: yadi na praṇayet rājā daṇḍam daṇḍyeṣu atandritaḥ

original: Manu7.20c/ śūle matsyān iva-apakṣyan durbalān balavattarāḥ ||
analyzed: śūle matsyān iva apakṣyan durbalān balavattarāḥ

original: Manu7.21a/ adyāt kākaḥ puroḍāśaṃ  śvā ca lihyādd havis tathā | [M.śvā-avalihyādd]
analyzed: adyāt kākaḥ puroḍāśam śvā ca lihyāt haviḥ tathā

original: Manu7.21c/ svāmyaṃ ca na syāt kasmiṃś cit pravarteta-adhara.uttaram ||
analyzed: svāmyam ca na syāt kasmin cit pravarteta adharauttaram

original: Manu7.22a/ sarvo daṇḍajito loko durlabho hi śucir naraḥ |
analyzed: sarvaḥ daṇḍa jitaḥ lokaḥ durlabhaḥ hi śuciḥ naraḥ

original: Manu7.22c/ daṇḍasya hi bhayāt sarvaṃ jagad bhogāya kalpate ||
analyzed: daṇḍasya hi bhayāt sarvam jagat bhogāya kalpate

original: Manu7.23a/ deva.dānava.gandharvā rakṣāṃsi pataga.uragāḥ |
analyzed: deva dānava gandharvāḥ rakṣāṃsi pataga auragāḥ

original: Manu7.23c/ te 'api bhogāya kalpante daṇḍena-eva nipīḍitāḥ ||
analyzed: te api bhogāya kalpante daṇḍena eva nipīḍitāḥ

original: Manu7.24a/ duṣyeyuḥ sarvavarṇāś ca bhidyeran sarvasetavaḥ |
analyzed: duṣyeyuḥ sarva varṇāḥ ca bhidyeran sarva setavaḥ

original: Manu7.24c/ sarvalokaprakopaś ca bhaved daṇḍasya vibhramāt ||
analyzed: sarva loka prakopaḥ ca bhavet daṇḍasya vibhramāt

original: Manu7.25a/ yatra śyāmo lohita.akṣo daṇḍaś carati pāpahā |
analyzed: yatra śyāmaḥ lohita akṣaḥ daṇḍaḥ carati pāpa hā

original: Manu7.25c/ prajās tatra na muhyanti netā cet sādhu paśyati ||
analyzed: prajāḥ tatra na muhyanti netā ced sādhu paśyati

original: Manu7.26a/ tasya-āhuḥ saṃpraṇetāraṃ rājānaṃ satyavādinam |
analyzed: tasya āhuḥ saṃpraṇetāram rājānam satya vādinam

original: Manu7.26c/ samīkṣyakāriṇaṃ prājñaṃ dharma.kāma.artha.kovidam ||
analyzed: samīkṣyakāriṇam prājñam dharma kāma artha kovidam

original: Manu7.27a/ taṃ rājā praṇayan samyak trivargeṇa-abhivardhate |
analyzed: tam rājā praṇayan samyak trivargeṇa abhivardhate

original: Manu7.27c/ kāma.ātmā viṣamaḥ kṣudro daṇḍena-eva nihanyate || [M.kāma.andho ]
analyzed: kāma ātmā viṣamaḥ kṣudraḥ daṇḍena eva nihanyate

original: Manu7.28a/ daṇḍo hi sumahat.tejo durdharaś ca-akṛta.ātmabhiḥ |
analyzed: daṇḍaḥ hi su mahā tejaḥ durdharaḥ ca akṛtaātmabhiḥ

original: Manu7.28c/ dharmād vicalitaṃ hanti nṛpam eva sa.bāndhavam ||
analyzed: dharmāt vicalitam hanti nṛpam eva sa bāndhavam

original: Manu7.29a/ tato durgaṃ ca rāṣṭraṃ ca lokaṃ ca sa.cara.acaram |
analyzed: tatas durgam ca rāṣṭram ca lokam ca sacaraacaram

original: Manu7.29c/ antarikṣagatāṃś ca-eva munīn devāṃś ca pīḍayet ||
analyzed: antarikṣa gatān ca eva munīn devān ca pīḍayet

original: Manu7.30a/ so 'asahāyena mūḍhena lubdhena-akṛta.buddhinā |
analyzed: saḥ asahāyena mūḍhena lubdhena akṛtabuddhinā

original: Manu7.30c/ na śakyo nyāyato netuṃ saktena viṣayeṣu ca ||
analyzed: na śakyaḥ nyāyataḥ netum saktena viṣayeṣu ca

original: Manu7.31a/ śucinā satyasaṃdhena yathāśāstra.anusāriṇā |
analyzed: śucinā satya saṃdhena yathā śāstra anusāriṇā

original: Manu7.31c/ praṇetuṃ śakyate daṇḍaḥ susahāyena dhīmatā ||
analyzed: praṇetum śakyate daṇḍaḥ su sahāyena dhīmatā

original: Manu7.32a/ svarāṣṭre nyāyavṛttaḥ syād bhṛśa.daṇḍaś ca śatruṣu |
analyzed: sva rāṣṭre nyāya vṛttaḥ syāt bhṛśa daṇḍaḥ ca śatruṣu

original: Manu7.32c/ suhṛtsv ajihmaḥ snigdheṣu brāhmaṇeṣu kṣamānvitaḥ ||
analyzed: suhṛtsu a jihmaḥ snigdheṣu brāhmaṇeṣu kṣamā anvitaḥ

original: Manu7.33a/ evaṃvṛttasya nṛpateḥ śilā.uñchena-api jīvataḥ |
analyzed: evaṃvṛttasya nṛpateḥ śilā uñchena api jīvataḥ

original: Manu7.33c/ vistīryate yaśo loke tailabindur iva-ambhasi ||
analyzed: vistīryate yaśaḥ loke taila binduḥ iva ambhasi

original: Manu7.34a/ atas tu viparītasya nṛpater ajita.ātmanaḥ |
analyzed: atas tu viparītasya nṛpateḥ ajita ātmanaḥ

original: Manu7.34c/ saṃkṣipyate yaśo loke ghṛtabindur iva-ambhasi ||
analyzed: saṃkṣipyate yaśaḥ loke ghṛta binduḥ iva ambhasi

original: Manu7.35a/ sve sve dharme niviṣṭānāṃ sarveṣām anupūrvaśaḥ |
analyzed: sve sve dharme niviṣṭānām sarveṣām anupūrvaśas

original: Manu7.35c/ varṇānām āśramāṇāṃ ca rājā sṛṣṭo 'abhirakṣitā ||
analyzed: varṇānām āśramāṇām ca rājā sṛṣṭaḥ abhirakṣitā

original: Manu7.36a/ tena yad yat sa.bhṛtyena kartavyaṃ rakṣatā prajāḥ |
analyzed: tena yat yat sa bhṛtyena kartavyam rakṣatā prajāḥ

original: Manu7.36c/ tat tad vo 'ahaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ ||
analyzed: tat tat vaḥ aham pravakṣyāmi yathāvat anupūrvaśas

original: Manu7.37a/ brāhmaṇān paryupāsīta prātar utthāya pārthivaḥ |
analyzed: brāhmaṇān paryupāsīta prātar utthāya pārthivaḥ

original: Manu7.37c/ traividyavṛddhān viduṣas tiṣṭhet teṣāṃ ca śāsane ||
analyzed: traividya vṛddhān viduṣaḥ tiṣṭhet teṣām ca śāsane

original: Manu7.38a/ vṛddhāṃś ca nityaṃ seveta viprān vedavidaḥ śucīn |
analyzed: vṛddhān ca nityam seveta viprān veda vidaḥ śucīn

original: Manu7.38c/ vṛddhasevī hi satataṃ rakṣobhir api pūjyate ||
analyzed: vṛddha sevī hi satatam rakṣobhiḥ api pūjyate

original: Manu7.39a/ tebhyo 'adhigacched vinayaṃ vinīta.ātmā-api nityaśaḥ |
analyzed: tebhyaḥ adhigacchet vinayam vinīta ātmā api nityaśas

original: Manu7.39c/ vinīta.ātmā hi nṛpatir na vinaśyati karhi cit ||
analyzed: vinīta ātmā hi nṛpatiḥ na vinaśyati karhi cit

original: Manu7.40a/ bahavo 'avinayāt- naṣṭā rājānaḥ sa.paricchadāḥ |[M.sa.parigrahāḥ]
analyzed: bahavaḥ avinayāt naṣṭāḥ rājānaḥ sa paricchadāḥ MSNM sa parigrahāḥ

original: Manu7.40c/ vanasthā api rājyāni vinayāt pratipedire ||
analyzed: vanasthāḥ api rājyāni vinayāt pratipedire

original: Manu7.41a/ veno vinaṣṭo 'avinayāt-nahuṣaś ca-eva pārthivaḥ |
analyzed: venaḥ vinaṣṭaḥ avinayāt nahuṣaḥ ca eva pārthivaḥ

original: Manu7.41c/ sudāḥ paijavanaś ca-eva sumukho nimir eva ca ||
analyzed: sudās paijavanaḥ ca eva sumukhaḥ nimiḥ eva ca

original: Manu7.42a/ pṛthus tu vinayād rājyaṃ prāptavān manur eva ca |
analyzed: pṛthuḥ tu vinayāt rājyam prāptavān manuḥ eva ca

original: Manu7.42c/ kuberaś ca dhanaiśvaryaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ ca-eva gādhijaḥ ||
analyzed: kuberaḥ ca dhana aiśvaryam brāhmaṇyam ca eva gādhijaḥ

original: Manu7.43a/ traividyebhyas trayīṃ vidyāṃ daṇḍanītiṃ ca śāśvatīm | [M.trayīṃ vidyāt ]
analyzed: traividyebhyaḥ trayīm vidyām daṇḍanītim ca śāśvatīm

original: Manu7.43c/ ānvīkṣikīṃ ca-ātmavidyāṃ vārtārambhāṃś ca lokataḥ ||
analyzed: ānvīkṣikīm ca ātma vidyām vārttā ārambhān ca lokatas

original: Manu7.44a/ indriyāṇāṃ jaye yogaṃ samātiṣṭhed divā.niśam |
analyzed: indriyāṇām jaye yogam samātiṣṭhet divāniśam

original: Manu7.44c/ jita.indriyo hi śaknoti vaśe sthāpayituṃ prajāḥ ||
analyzed: jita aindriyaḥ hi śaknoti vaśe sthāpayitum prajāḥ

original: Manu7.45a/ daśa kāma.samutthāni tathā-aṣṭau krodhajāni ca |
analyzed: daśa kāma samutthāni tathā aṣṭau krodha jāni ca

original: Manu7.45c/ vyasanāni dur.antāni prayatnena vivarjayet ||
analyzed: vyasanāni durantāni prayatnena vivarjayet

original: Manu7.46a/ kāmajeṣu prasakto hi vyasaneṣu mahīpatiḥ |
analyzed: kāma jeṣu prasaktaḥ hi vyasaneṣu mahīpatiḥ

original: Manu7.46c/ viyujyate 'artha.dharmābhyāṃ krodhajeṣv ātmanā-eva tu ||
analyzed: viyujyate artha dharmābhyām krodha jeṣu ātmanā eva tu

original: Manu7.47a/ mṛgayā-akṣo divāsvapnaḥ parivādaḥ striyo madaḥ |
analyzed: mṛgayā akṣaḥ divāsvapnaḥ parivādaḥ striyaḥ madaḥ

original: Manu7.47c/ tauryatrikaṃ vṛthāṭyā ca kāmajo daśako gaṇaḥ ||
analyzed: tauryatrikam vṛthāṭyā ca kāma jaḥ daśakaḥ gaṇaḥ

original: Manu7.48a/ paiśunyaṃ sāhasaṃ droha īrṣyā.asūyā.arthadūṣaṇam |
analyzed: paiśunyam sāhasam drohaḥ īrṣyā asūyā artha dūṣaṇam

original: Manu7.48c/ vāgdaṇḍajaṃ ca pāruṣyaṃ krodhajo 'api gaṇo 'aṣṭakaḥ ||
analyzed: vāgdaṇḍa jam ca pāruṣyam krodha jaḥ api gaṇaḥ aṣṭakaḥ

original: Manu7.49a/ dvayor apy etayor mūlaṃ yaṃ sarve kavayo viduḥ |
analyzed: dvayoḥ api etayoḥ mūlam yam sarve kavayaḥ viduḥ

original: Manu7.49c/ taṃ yatnena jayet-lobhaṃ tajjāv etāv ubhau gaṇau ||
analyzed: tam yatnena jayet lobham tad jau etau ubhau gaṇau

original: Manu7.50a/ pānam akṣāḥ striyaś ca-eva mṛgayā ca yathākramam |
analyzed: pānam akṣāḥ striyaḥ ca eva mṛgayā ca yathākramam

original: Manu7.50c/ etat kaṣṭatamaṃ vidyāt-catuṣkaṃ kāmaje gaṇe ||
analyzed: etat kaṣṭatamam vidyāt catuṣkam kāma je gaṇe

original: Manu7.51a/ daṇḍasya pātanaṃ ca-eva vākpāruṣya.arthadūṣaṇe |
analyzed: daṇḍasya pātanam ca eva vāc pāruṣya artha dūṣaṇe

original: Manu7.51c/ krodhaje 'api gaṇe vidyāt kaṣṭam etat trikaṃ sadā ||
analyzed: krodha je api gaṇe vidyāt kaṣṭam etat trikam sadā

original: Manu7.52a/ saptakasya-asya vargasya sarvatra-eva-anuṣaṅgiṇaḥ |
analyzed: saptakasya asya vargasya sarvatra eva anuṣaṅgiṇaḥ

original: Manu7.52c/ pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ gurutaraṃ vidyād vyasanam ātmavān |
analyzed: pūrvam pūrvam gurutaram vidyāt vyasanam ātmavān

original: Manu7.53a/ vyasanasya ca mṛtyoś ca vyasanaṃ kaṣṭam ucyate |

analyzed: anabhyāsena vedānām ācārasya ca varjanāt

original: Manu5.04c/ ālasyād annadoṣāc ca mṛtyur viprāñ jighāṃsati ||[M.viprān]
analyzed: ālasyāt anna doṣāt ca mṛtyuḥ viprān jighāṃsati

original: Manu5.05a/ laśunaṃ gṛñjanaṃ ca-eva palāṇḍuṃ kavakāni ca |
analyzed: laśunam gṛñjanam ca eva palāṇḍum kavakāni ca

original: Manu5.05c/ abhakṣyāṇi dvijātīnām amedhya.prabhavāni ca ||
analyzed: abhakṣyāṇi dvijātīnām amedhya prabhavāni ca

original: Manu5.06a/ lohitān vṛkṣaniryāsān vṛścana.prabhavāṃs tathā | [M.vraścana.prabhavāṃs ]
analyzed: lohitān vṛkṣa niryāsān vṛścana prabhavān tathā

original: Manu5.06c/ śeluṃ gavyaṃ ca peyūṣaṃ prayatnena vivarjayet || [M.pīyūṣaṃ ]
analyzed: śelum gavyam ca peyūṣam prayatnena vivarjayet

original: Manu5.07a/ vṛthā kṛsara.saṃyāvaṃ pāyasa.apūpam eva ca |
analyzed: vṛthā kṛsara saṃyāvam pāyasa apūpam eva ca

original: Manu5.07c/ an.upākṛtamāṃsāni devānnāni havīṃṣi ca ||
analyzed: an upākṛta māṃsāni deva annāni havīṃṣi ca

original: Manu5.08a/ a.nirdaśāyā goḥ kṣīram auṣṭram aikaśaphaṃ tathā |
analyzed: anirdaśāyāḥ goḥ kṣīram auṣṭram aikaśapham tathā

original: Manu5.08c/ āvikaṃ saṃdhinīkṣīraṃ vi.vatsāyāś ca goḥ payaḥ ||[M.sandhinīkṣīraṃ]
analyzed: āvikam saṃdhinī kṣīram vivatsāyāḥ ca goḥ payaḥ

original: Manu5.09a/ āraṇyānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ mṛgāṇāṃ māhiṣaṃ vinā |
analyzed: āraṇyānām ca sarveṣām mṛgāṇām māhiṣam vinā

original: Manu5.09c/ strīkṣīraṃ ca-eva varjyāni sarvaśuktāni ca-eva hi ||
analyzed: strī kṣīram ca eva varjyāni sarva śuktāni ca eva hi

original: Manu5.10a/ dadhi bhakṣyaṃ ca śukteṣu sarvaṃ ca dadhi.saṃbhavam | [M.dadhi.saṃbhavam]
analyzed: dadhi bhakṣyam ca śukteṣu sarvam ca dadhi saṃbhavam

original: Manu5.10c/ yāni ca-eva-abhiṣūyante puṣpa.mūla.phalaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
analyzed: yāni ca eva abhiṣūyante puṣpa mūla phalaiḥ śubhaiḥ

original: Manu5.11a/ kravyādāñ śakunān sarvān- tathā grāmanivāsinaḥ |  [M.kravyādaḥ śakunīn]
analyzed: kravyādān śakunān sarvān tathā grāma nivāsinaḥ

original: Manu5.11c/ a.nirdiṣṭāṃś ca-ekaśaphāṃṣ ṭiṭṭibhaṃ ca vivarjayet ||
analyzed: a nirdiṣṭān ca ekaśaphān ṭiṭṭibham ca vivarjayet

original: Manu5.12a/ kalaviṅkaṃ plavaṃ haṃsaṃ cakrāhvaṃ grāmakukkuṭam |
analyzed: kalaviṅkam plavam haṃsam cakrāhvam grāma kukkuṭam

original: Manu5.12c/ sārasaṃ rajjuvālaṃ ca dātyūhaṃ śuka.sārike || [M.rajjudālaṃ]
analyzed: sārasam rajjuvālam ca dātyūham śuka sārike

original: Manu5.13a/ pratudāñ jālapādāṃś ca koyaṣṭi.nakhaviṣkirān | [M.pratudān]
analyzed: pratudān jālapādān ca koyaṣṭi nakhaviṣkirān

original: Manu5.13c/ nimajjataś ca matsyādān saunaṃ vallūram eva ca ||
analyzed: nimajjataḥ ca matsya ādān saunam vallūram eva ca

original: Manu5.14a/ bakaṃ ca-eva balākāṃ ca kākolaṃ khañjarīṭakam |
analyzed: bakam ca eva balākām ca kākolam khañjarīṭakam

original: Manu5.14c/ matsyādān viḍvarāhāṃś ca matsyān eva ca sarvaśaḥ ||
analyzed: matsya ādān viḍvarāhān ca matsyān eva ca sarvaśas

original: Manu5.15a/ yo yasya māṃsam aśnāti sa tanmāṃsāda ucyate |
analyzed: yaḥ yasya māṃsam aśnāti sa tad māṃsa ādaḥ ucyate

original: Manu5.15c/ matsyādaḥ sarvamāṃsādas tasmān matsyān vivarjayet ||
analyzed: matsya ādaḥ sarva māṃsa ādaḥ tasmāt matsyān vivarjayet

original: Manu5.16a/ pāṭhīna.rohitāv ādyau niyuktau havya.kavyayoḥ |
analyzed: pāṭhīna rohitau ādyau niyuktau havya kavyayoḥ

original: Manu5.16c/ rājīvān siṃhatuṇḍāś ca sa.śalkāś ca-eva sarvaśaḥ || [M.rājīvāḥ ]
analyzed: rājīvān siṃhatuṇḍāḥ ca sa śalkāḥ ca eva sarvaśas

original: Manu5.17a/ na bhakṣayed ekacarān ajñātāṃś ca mṛga.dvijān |
analyzed: na bhakṣayet ekacarān ajñātān ca mṛga dvijān

original: Manu5.17c/ bhakṣyeṣv api samuddiṣṭān sarvān pañcanakhāṃs tathā ||
analyzed: bhakṣyeṣu api samuddiṣṭān sarvān pañcanakhān tathā

original: Manu5.18a/ śvāvidhaṃ śalyakaṃ godhāṃ khaḍga.kūrma.śaśāṃs tathā |
analyzed: śvāvidham śalyakam godhām khaḍga kūrma śaśān tathā

original: Manu5.18c/ bhakṣyān pañcanakheṣv āhur anuṣṭrāṃś ca-ekatodatah ||
analyzed: bhakṣyān pañcanakheṣu āhuḥ an uṣṭrān

original: Manu5.19a/ chatrākaṃ viḍvarāhaṃ ca laśunaṃ grāmakukkuṭam |
analyzed: chatrākam viḍvarāham ca laśunam grāma kukkuṭam

original: Manu5.19c/ palāṇḍuṃ gṛñjanaṃ ca-eva matyā jagdhvā pated dvijaḥ ||
analyzed: palāṇḍum gṛñjanam ca eva matyā jagdhvā patet dvijaḥ

original: Manu5.20a/ a.matyā-etāni ṣaḍ jagdhvā kṛcchraṃ sāntapanaṃ caret |
analyzed: amatyā etāni ṣaḍ jagdhvā kṛcchram sāntapanam caret

original: Manu5.20c/ yaticāndrāyāṇaṃ vā-api śeṣeṣu-upavased ahaḥ ||
analyzed: yaticāndrāyāṇam vā api śeṣeṣu upavaset ahar

original: Manu5.21a/ saṃvatsarasya-ekam api caret kṛcchraṃ dvijottamaḥ |
analyzed: saṃvatsarasya ekam api caret kṛcchram dvijottamaḥ

original: Manu5.21c/ a.jñātabhuktaśuddhi.arthaṃ jñātasya tu viṣeśataḥ ||
analyzed: ajñāta bhukta śuddhi artham jñātasya tu viṣa īśataḥ

original: Manu5.22a/ yajñārthaṃ brāhmaṇair vadhyāḥ praśastā mṛga.pakṣiṇaḥ |
analyzed: yajña artham brāhmaṇaiḥ vadhyāḥ praśastāḥ mṛga pakṣiṇaḥ

original: Manu5.22c/ bhṛtyānāṃ ca-eva vṛtti.artham agastyo hy ācarat purā ||
analyzed: bhṛtyānām ca eva vṛtti artham agastyaḥ hi ācarat purā

original: Manu5.23a/ babhūvur hi puroḍāśā bhakṣyāṇāṃ mṛga.pakṣiṇām |
analyzed: babhūvuḥ hi puroḍāśāḥ bhakṣyāṇām mṛga pakṣiṇām

original: Manu5.23c/ purāṇeṣv api yajñeṣu brahma.kṣatrasaveṣu ca || [[M.purāṇeṣv ṛṣiyajñeṣu]
analyzed: purāṇeṣu api yajñeṣu brahma kṣatra saveṣu ca purāṇeṣu ṛṣi yajñeṣu

original: Manu5.24a/ yat kiṃ cit snehasaṃyuktaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhojyam a.garhitam |
analyzed: yat kim cit sneha saṃyuktam bhakṣyam bhojyam agarhitam

original: Manu5.24c/ tat paryuṣitam apy ādyaṃ haviḥśeṣaṃ ca yad bhavet ||
analyzed: tat paryuṣitam api ādyam haviḥ śeṣam ca yat bhavet

original: Manu5.25a/ cirasthitam api tv ādyam a.snehāktaṃ dvijātibhiḥ |
analyzed: cira sthitam api tu ādyam asneha aktam dvijātibhiḥ

original: Manu5.25c/ yava.godhūmajaṃ sarvaṃ payasaś ca-eva vikriyā ||
analyzed: yava godhūma jam sarvam payasaḥ ca eva vikriyā

original: Manu5.26a/ etad uktaṃ dvijātīnāṃ bhakṣya.abhakṣyam a.śeṣataḥ |
analyzed: etat uktam dvijātīnām bhakṣya abhakṣyam aśeṣatas

original: Manu5.26c/ māṃsasya-ataḥ pravakṣyāmi vidhiṃ bhakṣaṇavarjane ||
analyzed: māṃsasya atas pravakṣyāmi vidhim bhakṣaṇa varjane

original: Manu5.27a/ prokṣitaṃ bhakṣayen māṃsaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca kāmyayā |
analyzed: prokṣitam bhakṣayet māṃsam brāhmaṇānām ca kāmyayā

original: Manu5.27c/ yathāvidhi niyuktas tu prāṇānām eva ca-atyaye ||
analyzed: yathāvidhi niyuktaḥ tu prāṇānām eva ca atyaye

original: Manu5.28a/ prāṇasya-annam idaṃ sarvaṃ prajāpatir akalpayat |
analyzed: prāṇasya annam idam sarvam prajāpatiḥ akalpayat

original: Manu5.28c/ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca-eva sarvaṃ prāṇasya bhojanam ||
analyzed: sthāvaram jaṅgamam ca eva sarvam prāṇasya bhojanam

original: Manu5.29a/ carāṇām annam a.carā daṃṣṭriṇām apy a.daṃṣṭriṇaḥ |
analyzed: carāṇām annam acarāḥ daṃṣṭriṇām api adaṃṣṭriṇaḥ

original: Manu5.29c/ a.hastāś ca sa.hastānāṃ śūrāṇāṃ ca-eva bhīravaḥ ||
analyzed: ahastāḥ ca sa hastānām śūrāṇām ca eva bhīravaḥ

original: Manu5.30a/ na-attā duṣyaty adann ādyān prāṇino 'ahany.ahany api |
analyzed: na attā duṣyati adan ādyān prāṇinaḥ ahani ahani api

original: Manu5.30c/ dhātrā-eva sṛṣṭā hy ādyāś ca prāṇino 'attāra eva ca ||
analyzed: dhātrā eva sṛṣṭāḥ hi ādyāḥ ca prāṇinaḥ attāraḥ eva ca

original: Manu5.31a/ yajñāya jagdhir māṃsasya-ity eṣa daivo vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
analyzed: yajñāya jagdhiḥ māṃsasya eti eṣa daivaḥ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ

original: Manu5.31c/ ato 'anyathā pravṛttis tu rākṣaso vidhir ucyate ||
analyzed: atas anyathā pravṛttiḥ tu rākṣasaḥ vidhiḥ ucyate

original: Manu5.32a/ krītvā svayaṃ vā-apy utpādya para.upakṛtam eva vā |
analyzed: krītvā svayam utpādya para aupakṛtam eva vā

original: Manu5.32c/ devān pitqṃś ca-arcayitvā khādan māṃsaṃ na duṣyati ||
analyzed: devān pitqn ca arcayitvā khādat māṃsam na duṣyati

original: Manu5.33a/ na-adyād avidhinā māṃsaṃ vidhijño 'anāpadi dvijaḥ |
analyzed: na adyāt avidhinā māṃsam vidhi jñaḥ anāpadi dvijaḥ

original: Manu5.33c/ jagdhvā hy a.vidhinā māṃsaṃ pretas tair adyate 'a.vaśaḥ ||
analyzed: jagdhvā hi avidhinā māṃsam pretaḥ taiḥ adyate avaśaḥ

original: Manu5.34a/ na tādṛśaṃ bhavaty eno mṛgahantur dhanārthinaḥ |
analyzed: na tādṛśam bhavati enaḥ mṛga hantuḥ dhana arthinaḥ

original: Manu5.34c/ yādṛśaṃ bhavati pretya vṛthāmāṃsāni khādataḥ ||
analyzed: yādṛśam bhavati pretya vṛthāmāṃsāni khādataḥ

original: Manu5.35a/ niyuktas tu yathānyāyaṃ yo māṃsaṃ na-atti mānavaḥ |
analyzed: niyuktaḥ tu yathānyāyam yaḥ māṃsam naatti mānavaḥ

original: Manu5.35c/ sa pretya paśutāṃ yāti saṃbhavān ekaviṃśatim ||
analyzed: sa pretya paśu tām yāti saṃbhavān ekaviṃśatim

original: Manu5.36a/ asaṃskṛtān paśūn mantrair na-adyād vipraḥ kadā cana |
analyzed: a saṃskṛtān paśūn mantraiḥ na adyāt vipraḥ kadā cana

original: Manu5.36c/ mantrais tu saṃskṛtān adyāt-śāśvataṃ vidhim āsthitaḥ ||
analyzed: mantraiḥ tu saṃskṛtān adyāt śāśvatam vidhim āsthitaḥ

original: Manu5.37a/ kuryād ghṛtapaśuṃ saṅge kuryāt piṣṭapaśuṃ tathā |
analyzed: kuryāt ghṛtapaśum saṅge kuryāt piṣṭapaśum tathā

original: Manu5.37c/ na tv eva tu vṛthā hantuṃ paśum icchet kadā cana ||
analyzed: na tu eva tu vṛthak hantum paśum icchet kadā cana

original: Manu5.38a/ yāvanti paśuromāṇi tāvatkṛtvo ha māraṇam |
analyzed: yāvanti paśu romāṇi tāvat kṛtvas ha māraṇam

original: Manu5.38c/ vṛthāpaśughnaḥ prāpnoti pretya janmani janmani ||
analyzed: vṛthak paśu ghnaḥ prāpnoti pretya janmani janmani

original: Manu5.39a/ yajñārthaṃ paśavaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayam eva svayaṃbhuvā |
analyzed: yajña artham paśavaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayam eva svayaṃbhuvā

original: Manu5.39c/ yajño 'asya bhūtyai sarvasya tasmād yajñe vadho 'a.vadhaḥ ||
analyzed: yajñaḥ asya bhūtyai sarvasya tasmāt yajñe vadhaḥ a vadhaḥ

original: Manu5.40a/ oṣadhyaḥ paśavo vṛkṣās tiryañcaḥ pakṣiṇas tathā |
analyzed: oṣadhyaḥ paśavaḥ vṛkṣāḥ tiryañcaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ tathā

original: Manu5.40c/ yajñārthaṃ nidhanaṃ prāptāḥ prāpnuvanty utsṛtīḥ  punaḥ || [M.ucchritīḥ]
analyzed: yajña artham nidhanam prāptāḥ prāpnuvanti utsṛtīḥ punar

original: Manu5.41a/ madhuparke ca yajñe ca pitṛ.daivatakarmaṇi |
analyzed: madhuparke ca yajñe ca pitṛ daivata karmaṇi

original: Manu5.41c/ atra-eva paśavo hiṃsyā na-anyatra-ity abravīn manuḥ ||
analyzed: atra eva paśavaḥ hiṃsyāḥ na anyatra eti abravīt manuḥ

original: Manu5.42a/ eṣv artheṣu paśūn hiṃsan vedatattvārthavid dvijaḥ |
analyzed: eṣu artheṣu paśūn hiṃsan veda tattva artha vid dvijaḥ

original: Manu5.42c/ ātmānaṃ ca paśuṃ ca-eva gamayaty uttamaṃ gatim ||
analyzed: ātmānam ca paśum ca eva gamayati uttamam gatim

original: Manu5.43a/ gṛhe gurāv araṇye vā nivasann ātmavān dvijaḥ |
analyzed: gṛhe gurau araṇye vā nivasan ātmavān dvijaḥ

original: Manu5.43c/ na-a.vedavihitāṃ hiṃsām āpady api samācaret ||
analyzed: na a veda vihitām hiṃsām āpadi api samācaret

original: Manu5.44a/ yā vedavihitā hiṃsā niyatā-asmiṃś cara.acare |
analyzed: yā veda vihitā hiṃsā niyatā asmin cara acare

original: Manu5.44c/ ahiṃsām eva tāṃ vidyād vedād dharmo hi nirbabhau ||
analyzed: ahiṃsām eva tām vidyāt vedāt dharmaḥ hi nirbabhau

original: Manu5.45a/ yo 'ahiṃsakāni bhūtāni hinasty ātmasukha.icchayā |
analyzed: yaḥ ahiṃsakāni bhūtāni hinasti ātma sukha ecchayā

original: Manu5.45c/ sa jīvāṃś ca mṛtaś ca-eva na kva cit sukham edhate ||
analyzed: sa jīvān ca mṛtaḥ ca eva na kva cit sukham edhate

original: Manu5.46a/ yo bandhanavadhakleśān prāṇināṃ na cikīrṣati |
analyzed: yaḥ bandhana vadha kleśān prāṇinām na cikīrṣati

original: Manu5.46c/ sa sarvasya hitaprepsuḥ sukham atyantam aśnute ||
analyzed: sa sarvasya hita prepsuḥ sukham atyantam aśnute

original: Manu5.47a/ yad dhyāyati yat kurute ratiṃ badhnāti yatra ca |
analyzed: yat dhyāyati yat kurute ratim badhnāti yatra ca

original: Manu5.47c/ tad avāpnoty ayatnena yo hinasti na kiṃ cana ||
analyzed: tat avāpnoti ayatnena yaḥ hinasti na kim cana

original: Manu5.48a/ na-a.kṛtvā prāṇināṃ hiṃsāṃ māṃsam utpadyate kva cit |
analyzed: na a kṛtvā prāṇinām hiṃsām māṃsam utpadyate kva cit

original: Manu5.48c/ na ca prāṇivadhaḥ svargyas tasmān māṃsaṃ vivarjayet ||
analyzed: na ca prāṇi vadhaḥ svargyaḥ tasmāt māṃsam vivarjayet

original: Manu5.49a/ samutpattiṃ ca māṃsasya vadha.bandhau ca dehinām |
analyzed: samutpattim ca māṃsasya vadha bandhau ca dehinām

original: Manu5.49c/ prasamīkṣya nivarteta sarvamāṃsasya bhakṣaṇāt ||
analyzed: prasamīkṣya nivarteta sarva māṃsasya bhakṣaṇāt

original: Manu5.50a/ na bhakṣayati yo māṃsaṃ vidhiṃ hitvā piśācavat |
analyzed: na bhakṣayati yaḥ māṃsam vidhim hitvā piśāca vat

original: Manu5.50c/ na loke priyatāṃ yāti vyādhibhiś ca na pīḍyate ||
analyzed: na loke priya tām yāti vyādhibhiḥ ca na pīḍyate

original: Manu5.51a/ anumantā viśasitā nihantā kraya.vikrayī |
analyzed: anumantā viśasitā nihantā kraya vikrayī

original: Manu5.51c/ saṃskartā ca-upahartā ca khādakaś ca-iti ghātakāḥ ||
analyzed: saṃskartā ca aupahartā ca khādakaḥ ca eti

original: Manu5.52a/ svamāṃsaṃ paramāṃsena yo vardhayitum icchati |
analyzed: sva māṃsam para māṃsena yaḥ vardhayitum icchati

original: Manu5.52c/ an.abhyarcya pitqn devāṃs tato 'anyo na-asty apuṇyakṛt ||
analyzed: an abhyarcya devān tatas anyaḥ na asti apuṇya kṛt

original: Manu5.53a/ varṣe varṣe 'aśvamedhena yo yajeta śataṃ samāḥ |
analyzed: varṣe varṣe aśvamedhena yaḥ yajeta śatam samāḥ

original: Manu5.53c/ māṃsāni ca na khāded yas tayoḥ puṇyaphalaṃ samam ||
analyzed: māṃsāni ca na khādet yaḥ tayoḥ puṇya phalam samam

original: Manu5.54a/ phala.mūla.aśanair medhyair muni.annānāṃ ca bhojanaiḥ |
analyzed: phala mūla aśanaiḥ medhyaiḥ muni annānām ca bhojanaiḥ

original: Manu5.54c/ na tat phalam avāpnoti yat-māṃsaparivarjanāt ||
analyzed: na tat phalam avāpnoti yat māṃsa parivarjanāt

original: Manu5.55a/ māṃ sa bhakṣayitā-amutra yasya māṃsam iha-admy aham |
analyzed: mām sa bhakṣayitā amutra yasya māṃsam iha admi aham

original: Manu5.55c/ etat-māṃsasya māṃsatvaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ||
analyzed: etat māṃsasya māṃsa tvam pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ

original: Manu5.56a/ na māṃsabhakṣaṇe doṣo na madye na ca maithune |
analyzed: na māṃsa bhakṣaṇe doṣaḥ na madye na ca maithune

original: Manu5.56c/ pravṛttir eṣā bhūtānāṃ nivṛttis tu mahāphalā ||
analyzed: pravṛttiḥ eṣā bhūtānām nivṛttiḥ tu mahā phalā

original: Manu5.57a/ pretaśuddhiṃ pravakṣyāmi) dravyaśuddhiṃ tathā-eva ca |
analyzed: preta śuddhim pravakṣyāmi dravya śuddhim tathā eva ca

original: Manu5.57c/ caturṇām api varṇānāṃ yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ ||

analyzed: sthānam samudayam guptim labdha praśamanāni ca

analyzed: śreṇīṣu śreṇi puruṣāḥ sveṣu vargeṣu vargiṇaḥ

original: N1.135c/ bahirvāsiṣu bāhyāś ca striyaḥ striṣu ca sākṣiṇaḥ //
analyzed: bahirvāsiṣu bāhyāḥ ca striyaḥ striṣu ca sākṣiṇaḥ

original: N1.136a/ śreṇyādiṣu tu vargeṣu kaścic ced dveṣyatām iyāt /
analyzed: śreṇi ādiṣu tu vargeṣu kaścid ced dveṣya tām iyāt

original: N1.136c/ tebhya eva na sākṣī syād dveṣṭāraḥ sarva eva te //
analyzed: tebhyaḥ eva na sākṣī syāt dveṣṭāraḥ sarve eva te

original: N1.137a/ asākṣy api hi śāstreṣu dṛṣṭaḥ pañcavidho budhaiḥ /
analyzed: asākṣī api hi śāstreṣu dṛṣṭaḥ pañcavidhaḥ budhaiḥ

original: N1.137c/ vacanād doṣato bhedāt svayamukter mṛtāntaraḥ //
analyzed: vacanāt doṣataḥ bhedāt svayamuktyāḥ mṛtāntaraḥ

original: N1.138a/ śrotriyādyā vacanataḥ stenādyā doṣadarśanāt /
analyzed: śrotriya ādyāḥ vacanataḥ stena ādyāḥ doṣa darśanāt

original: N1.138c/ bhedād vipratipattiḥ syād vivāde yatra sākṣiṇaḥ //
analyzed: bhedāt vipratipattiḥ syāt vivāde yatra sākṣiṇaḥ

original: N1.139a/ svayamukter anirdiṣṭaḥ svayam evaitya yo vadet /
analyzed: svayamukteḥ anirdiṣṭaḥ svayam eva etya yaḥ vadet

original: N1.139c/ mṛtāntaro 'arthini prete mumūrṣuśrāvitād ṛte //
analyzed: mṛtāntaraḥ arthini prete mumūrṣu śrāvitāt ṛte

original: N1.140a/ śrotriyās tāpasā vṛddhā ye ca pravrajitā narāḥ /
analyzed: śrotriyāḥ tāpasāḥ vṛddhāḥ ye ca pravrajitāḥ narāḥ

original: N1.140c/ asākṣiṇas te vacanān nātra hetur udāhṛtaḥ //
analyzed: asākṣiṇaḥ te vacanāt na atra hetuḥ udāhṛtaḥ

original: N1.141a/ stenāḥ sāhasikāś caṇḍāḥ kitavā vadhakās tathā /
analyzed: stenāḥ sāhasikāḥ caṇḍāḥ kitavāḥ vadhakāḥ tathā

original: N1.141c/ asākṣiṇas te duṣṭatvāt teṣu satyaṃ na vidyate //
analyzed: asākṣiṇaḥ te duṣṭa tvāt teṣu satyam na vidyate

original: N1.142a/ rājñā parigṛhīteṣu sākṣiṣv ekārthaniścaye /
analyzed: rājñā parigṛhīteṣu sākṣiṣu eka artha niścaye

original: N1.142c/ vacanaṃ yatra bhidyate te syur bhedād asākṣiṇaḥ //
analyzed: vacanam yatra bhidyate te syuḥ bhedāt asākṣiṇaḥ

original: N1.143a/ anirdiṣṭas tu sākṣitve svayam evaitya yo vadet /
analyzed: anirdiṣṭaḥ tu sākṣi tve svayam eva etya yaḥ vadet

original: N1.143c/ sūcīty uktaḥ sa śāstreṣu na sa sākṣitvam arhati //
analyzed: sūcī iti uktaḥ sa śāstreṣu na sa sākṣi tvam arhati

original: N1.144a/ yo 'arthaḥ śrāvayitavyaḥ syāt tasminn asati cārthini /
analyzed: yaḥ arthaḥ śrāvayitavyaḥ syāt tasmin asati ca arthini

original: N1.144c/ kva tad vadatu sākṣitvam ity asākṣī mṛtāntaraḥ //
analyzed: kva tat vadatu sākṣi tvam iti asākṣī mṛtāntaraḥ

original: N1.144-1a/ yo 'arthaḥ śrāvayitavyaḥ syāt tasminn asati cārthini /
analyzed: yaḥ arthaḥ śrāvayitavyaḥ syāt tasmin asati ca arthini

original: N1.144-1c/ kva tad vadatu sākṣitvam ity asākṣī mṛtāntaraḥ //
analyzed: kva tat vadatu sākṣi tvam iti asākṣī mṛtāntaraḥ

original: N1.145a/ dvayor vivadator arthe dvayoḥ satsu ca sākṣiṣu /
analyzed: dvayoḥ vivadatoḥ arthe dvayoḥ satsu ca sākṣiṣu

original: N1.145c/ pūrvapakṣo bhaved yasya bhaveyus tasya sākṣiṇaḥ //
analyzed: pūrvapakṣaḥ bhavet yasya bhaveyuḥ tasya sākṣiṇaḥ

original: N1.146a/ ādharyaṃ pūrvapakṣasya yasminn arthe vaśād bhavet /
analyzed: ādharyam pūrvapakṣasya yasmin arthe vaśāt bhavet

original: N1.146c/ praṣṭavyāḥ sākṣiṇas tatra vivāde prativādinaḥ //
analyzed: praṣṭavyāḥ sākṣiṇaḥ tatra vivāde prativādinaḥ

original: N1.147a/ na pareṇa samuddiṣṭam upeyāt sākṣiṇaṃ rahaḥ /
analyzed: na pareṇa samuddiṣṭam upeyāt sākṣiṇam rahaḥ

original: N1.147c/ bhedayet taṃ na cānyena hīyetaivaṃ samācaran //
analyzed: bhedayet tam na ca anyena hīyeta evam samācaran

original: N1.148a/ sākṣy uddiṣṭo yadi preyād gacched vāpi digantaram /
analyzed: sākṣī uddiṣṭaḥ yadi preyāt gacchet vā api digantaram

original: N1.148c/ tacchrotāraḥ pramāṇaṃ syuḥ pramāṇaṃ hy uttarakriyā //
analyzed: tad śrotāraḥ pramāṇam syuḥ pramāṇam hi uttara kriyā

original: N1.149a/ sudīrgheṇāpi kālena likhitaṃ siddhim āpnuyāt /
analyzed: su dīrghena api kālena likhitam siddhim āpnuyāt

original: N1.149c/ jānatā cātmanā lekhyaṃ ajānānas tu lekhayet //
analyzed: jānatā ca ātmanā lekhyam a jānānaḥ tu lekhayet

original: N1.150a/ siddhir uktāṣṭamād varṣāt smāritasyeha sākṣiṇaḥ /
analyzed: siddhiḥ uktā aṣṭamāt varṣāt smāritasya iha sākṣiṇaḥ

original: N1.150c/ ā pañcamāt tathā siddhir yadṛcchopagatasya tu //
analyzed: pañcamāt tathā siddhiḥ yadṛcchā upagatasya tu

original: N1.151a/ ā tṛtīyāt tathā varṣāt siddhir gūḍhasya sākṣiṇaḥ /
analyzed: tṛtīyāt tathā varṣāt siddhiḥ gūḍhasya sākṣiṇaḥ

original: N1.151c/ ā vai saṃvatsarāt siddhiṃ vadanty uttarasākṣiṇaḥ //
analyzed: ā vai saṃvatsarāt siddhim vadanti uttara sākṣiṇaḥ

original: N1.152a/ athavā kālaniyamo na dṛṣṭaḥ sākṣiṇaṃ prati /
analyzed: athavā kāla niyamaḥ na dṛṣṭaḥ sākṣiṇam prati

original: N1.152c/ smṛtyapekṣaṃ hi sākṣitvam āhuḥ śāstravido janāḥ //
analyzed: smṛti apekṣam hi sākṣi tvam āhuḥ śāstra vidaḥ janāḥ

original: N1.153a/ yasya nopahatā puṃsaḥ smṛtiḥ śrotraṃ ca nityaśaḥ /
analyzed: yasya na upahatā puṃsaḥ smṛtiḥ śrotram ca nityaśas

original: N1.153c/ sudīrgheṇāpi kālena sa sākṣī sākṣyam arhati //
analyzed: su dīrgheṇa api kālena sa sākṣī sākṣyam arhati

original: N1.154a/ asākṣipratyayās tv anye ṣaḍvivādāḥ prakīrtitāḥ /
analyzed: asākṣi pratyayāḥ tu anye ṣaṭ vivādāḥ prakīrtitāḥ

original: N1.154c/ lakṣaṇāny eva sākṣitvaṃ eṣām āhur manīṣiṇaḥ //
analyzed: lakṣaṇāni eva sākṣi tvam eṣām āhuḥ manīṣiṇaḥ

original: N1.155a/ ulkāhasto 'agnido jñeyaḥ śastrapāṇis tu ghātakaḥ /
analyzed: ulkā hastaḥ agnidaḥ jñeyaḥ śastra pāṇiḥ tu ghātakaḥ

original: N1.155c/ keśākeśigṛhītaś ca yugapat pāradārikaḥ //
analyzed: keśākeśi gṛhītaḥ ca yugapad pāradārikaḥ

original: N1.156a/ kuddālapāṇir vijñeyaḥ setubhettā samīpagaḥ /
analyzed: kuddāla pāṇiḥ vijñeyaḥ setu bhettā samīpa gaḥ

original: N1.156c/ tathā kuṭhārapāṇiś ca vanachettā prakīrtitaḥ //
analyzed: tathā kuṭhāra pāṇiḥ ca vana chettā prakīrtitaḥ

original: N1.157a/ abhyagracihno vijñeyo daṇḍapāruṣyakṛn naraḥ /
analyzed: abhyagra cihnaḥ vijñeyaḥ daṇḍa pāruṣya kṛt naraḥ

original: N1.157c/ asākṣipratyayā hy ete pāruṣye tu parīkṣaṇam //
analyzed: asākṣi pratyayāḥ hi ete pāruṣye tu parīkṣaṇam

original: N1.158a/ kaścit kṛtvātmanaś cihnaṃ dveṣāt param upadravet /
analyzed: kaścid kṛtvā ātmanaḥ cihnam dveṣāt param upadravet

original: N1.158c/ hetvarthagatisāmarthyais tatra yuktaṃ parīkṣaṇam //
analyzed: hetu artha gati sāmarthyaiḥ tatra yuktam parīkṣaṇam

original: N1.159a/ nārthasaṃbandhino nāptā na sahāyā na vairiṇaḥ /
analyzed: na artha saṃbandhinaḥ na āptāḥ na sahāyāḥ na vairiṇaḥ

original: N1.159c/ na dṛṣṭadoṣāḥ praṣṭavyāś na vyādhyārtā na dūṣitāḥ //
analyzed: na dṛṣṭa doṣāḥ praṣṭavyāḥ na vyādhi ārtāḥ na dūṣitāḥ

original: N1.160a/ dāsanaikṛtikāśraddhavṛddhastrībālacākrikāḥ /
analyzed: dāsa naikṛtika aśraddha vṛddha strī bāla cākrikāḥ

original: N1.160c/ mattonmattapramattārtakitavagrāmayājakāḥ //
analyzed: matta unmatta pramatta ārta kitava grāmayājakāḥ

original: N1.161a/ mahāpathikasāmudravaṇikpravrajitāturāḥ /
analyzed: mahāpathika sāmudra vaṇij pravrajita āturāḥ

original: N1.161c/ lubdhakaśrotriyācārahīnaklībakuśīlavāḥ //
analyzed: lubdhaka śrotriya ācāra hīna klība kuśīlavāḥ

original: N1.162a/ nāstikavrātyadārāgnityāgino 'ayājyayājakāḥ /
analyzed: nāstika vrātya dāra agni tyāginaḥ a yājya yājakāḥ

original: N1.162c/ ekasthālīsahāyāricarajñātisanābhayaḥ //
analyzed: eka sthālī sahāya ari cara jñāti sanābhayaḥ

original: N1.163a/ prāgdṛṣṭadoṣaśailūṣaviṣajīvyahituṇḍikāḥ /
analyzed: prāk dṛṣṭa doṣa śailūṣa viṣa jīvi ahituṇḍikāḥ

original: N1.163c/ garadāgnidakīnāśaśūdrāputropapātikāḥ // a
analyzed: garada agnida kīnāśa śūdrā putra upapātikāḥ a

original: N1.164a/ klāntasāhasikaśrāntanirdhanāntyāvasāyinaḥ /
analyzed: klānta sāhasika śrānta nirdhana antyāvasāyinaḥ

original: N1.164c/ bhinnavṛttāsamāvṛttajaḍatailikamūlikāḥ //
analyzed: bhinna vṛtta asama avṛtta jaḍa tailika mūlikāḥ

original: N1.165a/ bhūtāviṣṭanṛpadviṣṭavarṣanakṣatrasūcakāḥ /
analyzed: bhūta āviṣṭa nṛpa dviṣṭa varṣa nakṣatra sūcakāḥ

original: N1.165c/ aghaśaṃsyātmavikretṛhīnāṅgabhagavṛttayaḥ //
analyzed: agha śaṃsi ātma vikretṛ hīna aṅga bhaga vṛttayaḥ

original: N1.166a/ kunakhī śyāvadan śvitrimitradhrukśaṭhaśauṇḍikāḥ /
analyzed: kunakhī śvitri mitra druh śaṭha śauṇḍikāḥ

original: N1.166c/ aindrajālikalubdhograśreṇīgaṇavirodhinaḥ //
analyzed: aindrajālika lubdha ugra śreṇi gaṇa virodhinaḥ

original: N1.167a/ vadhakṛccitrakṛnmaṅkhaḥ patitaḥ kūṭakārakaḥ /
analyzed: patitaḥ kūṭa kārakaḥ

original: N1.167c/ kuhakaḥ pratyavasitas taskaro rājapūruṣaḥ /
analyzed: kuhakaḥ pratyavasitaḥ taskaraḥ rāja pūruṣaḥ

original: N1.168a/ manuṣyaviṣaśastrāmbulavaṇāpūpavīrudhām /
analyzed: manuṣya viṣa śastra ambu lavaṇa apūpa vīrudhām

original: N1.168c/ vikretā brāhmaṇaś caiva dvijo vārdhuṣikaś ca yaḥ //
analyzed: vikretā brāhmaṇaḥ ca eva dvijaḥ vārddhuṣikaḥ ca yaḥ

original: N1.169a/ cyutaḥ svadharmāt kulikaḥ stāvako hīnasevakaḥ /
analyzed: cyutaḥ svadharmāt kulikaḥ stāvakaḥ hīna sevakaḥ

original: N1.169c/ pitrā vivadamānaś ca bhedakṛc cety asākṣiṇaḥ //
analyzed: pitrā vivadamānaḥ ca bheda kṛt ca iti asākṣiṇaḥ

original: N1.170a/ asākṣiṇo ye nirdiṣṭā dāsanaikṛtikādayaḥ /
analyzed: asākṣiṇaḥ ye nirdiṣṭāḥ dāsa naikṛtika ādayaḥ

original: N1.170c/ kāryagauravam āsādya bhaveyus te 'api sākṣiṇaḥ //
analyzed: kārya gauravam āsādya bhaveyuḥ te api sākṣiṇaḥ

original: N1.171a/ sāhaseṣu ca sarveṣu steyasaṃgrahaṇeṣu ca /
analyzed: sāhaseṣu ca sarveṣu steya saṃgrahaṇeṣu ca

original: N1.171c/ pāruṣyayoś cāpy ubhayor na parīkṣeta sākṣiṇaḥ //
analyzed: pāruṣyayoḥ ca api ubhayayoḥ na parīkṣeta sākṣiṇaḥ

original: N1.172a/ teṣām api na bālaḥ syān naiko na strī na kūṭakṛt /
analyzed: teṣām api na bālaḥ syāt na ekaḥ na strī na kūṭa kṛt

original: N1.172c/ na bāndhavo na cārātir brūyus te sākṣyam anyathā //
analyzed: na bāndhavaḥ na ca arātiḥ brūyuḥ te sākṣyam anyathā

original: N1.173a/ bālo 'ajñānād asatyāt strī pāpābhyāsāc ca kūṭakṛt /
analyzed: bālaḥ ajñānāt asatyāt strī pāpa abhyāsāt ca kūṭa kṛt

original: N1.173c/ vibrūyād bāndhavaḥ snehād vairaniryātanād ariḥ //
analyzed: vibrūyāt bāndhavaḥ snehāt vaira niryātanāt ariḥ

original: N1.174a/ athavānumato yaḥ syād dvayor vivadamānayoḥ /
analyzed: athavā anumataḥ yaḥ syāt dvayoḥ vivadamānayoḥ

original: N1.174c/ asākṣy eko 'api sākṣitve praṣṭavyaḥ syāt sa saṃsadi //
analyzed: asākṣī ekaḥ api sākṣi tve praṣṭavyaḥ syāt sa saṃsadi

original: N1.175a/ yas tv ātmadoṣabhinnatvād asvastha iva lakṣyate /
analyzed: yaḥ tu ātma doṣa bhinna tvāt asvasthaḥ iva lakṣyate

original: N1.175c/ sthānāt sthānāntaraṃ gacched ekaikaṃ copadhāvati //
analyzed: sthānāt sthāna antaram gacchet ekaikam ca upadhāvati

original: N1.176a/ kāsate 'anibhṛto 'akasmād abhīkṣṇaṃ niśvasaty api /
analyzed: kāsate anibhṛtaḥ akasmāt abhīkṣṇam niśvasati api

original: N1.176c/ bhūmiṃ likhati pādābhyāṃ bāhu vāso dhunoti ca //
analyzed: bhūmim likhati pādābhyām bāhu vāsaḥ dhunoti ca

original: N1.177a/ bhidyate mukhavarṇo 'asya lalāṭaṃ svidyate tathā /
analyzed: bhidyate mukha varṇaḥ asya lalāṭam svidyate tathā

original: N1.177c/ śoṣam āgacchataś coṣṭhāv ūrdhvaṃ tiryak ca vīkṣate //
analyzed: śoṣam āgacchataḥ ca uṣṭhau ūrdhvam tiryak ca vīkṣate

original: N1.178a/ tvaramāṇa ivābaddham apṛṣṭo bahu bhāṣate /
analyzed: tvaramāṇaḥ iva abaddham apṛṣṭaḥ bahu bhāṣate

original: N1.178c/ kūṭasākṣī sa vijñeyas taṃ pāpaṃ vinayen nṛpaḥ //
analyzed: kūṭa sākṣī sa vijñeyaḥ tam pāpam vinayet nṛpaḥ

original: N1.179a/ śrāvayitvā ca yo 'anyebhyaḥ sākṣitvaṃ tad vinihnute /
analyzed: śrāvayitvā ca yaḥ anyebhyaḥ sākṣi tvam tat vinihnute

original: N1.179c/ sa vineyo bhṛśataraṃ kūṭasākṣyadhiko hi saḥ //
analyzed: sa vineyaḥ bhṛśataram kūṭa sākṣī adhikaḥ hi saḥ

original: N1.180a/ āhūya sākṣiṇaḥ pṛcchen niyamya śapathair bhṛśam /
analyzed: āhūya sākṣiṇaḥ pṛcchet niyamya śapathaiḥ bhṛśam

original: N1.180c/ samastān viditācārān vijñātārthān pṛthak pṛthak //
analyzed: samastān vidita ācārān vijñāta arthān pṛthak pṛthak

original: N1.181a/ satyena śāpayed vipraṃ kṣatriyaṃ vāhanāyudhaiḥ /
analyzed: satyena śāpayet vipram kṣatriyam vāhana āyudhaiḥ

original: N1.181c/ gobījakāñcanair vaiśyaṃ śūdraṃ sarvais tu pātakaiḥ //
analyzed: go bīja kāñcanaiḥ vaiśyam śūdram sarvaiḥ tu pātakaiḥ

original: N1.182a/ purāṇair dharmavacanaiḥ satyamāhātmyakīrtanaiḥ /
analyzed: purāṇaiḥ dharma vacanaiḥ satya māhātmya kīrtanaiḥ

original: N1.182c/ anṛtasyāpavādaiś ca bhṛśam uttrāsya sākṣiṇaḥ //
analyzed: anṛtasya apavādaiḥ ca bhṛśam uttrāsya sākṣiṇaḥ

original: N1.183a/ nagno muṇḍaḥ kapālena bhikṣārthī kṣutpipāsitaḥ /
analyzed: nagnaḥ muṇḍaḥ kapālena bhikṣā arthī kṣudh pipāsitaḥ

original: N1.183c/ dīnaḥ śatrugṛhaṃ gacched yaḥ sākṣyam anṛtaṃ vadet //
analyzed: dīnaḥ śatru gṛham gacchet yaḥ sākṣyam anṛtam vadet

original: N1.184a/ nagare pratiruddhaḥ san bahirdvāre bubhukṣitaḥ /
analyzed: nagare pratiruddhaḥ san bahirdvāre bubhukṣitaḥ

original: N1.184c/ amitrān bhūyaśaḥ paśyed yaḥ sākṣyam anṛtaṃ vadet //
analyzed: amitrān bhūyaśas paśyet yaḥ sākṣyam anṛtam vadet

original: N1.185a/ yāṃ rātrim adhivinnā strī yāṃ caivākṣaparājitaḥ /
analyzed: yām rātrim adhivinnā strī yām ca eva akṣa parājitaḥ

original: N1.185c/ yāṃ ca bhārābhitaptāṅgo durvivaktā sa tāṃ vaset //
analyzed: yām ca bhāra abhitapta aṅgaḥ durvivaktā sa tām vaset

original: N1.186a/ sākṣī sākṣyasamuddeśe gokarṇaśithilaṃ caran /
analyzed: sākṣī sākṣya samuddeśe gokarṇa śithilam caran

original: N1.186c/ sahasraṃ vāruṇān pāśān ātmani pratimuñcati //
analyzed: sahasram vāruṇān pāśān ātmani pratimuñcati

original: N1.187a/ tasya varṣaśate pūrṇe pāśam ekaṃ pramucyate /
analyzed: tasya varṣa śate pūrṇe pāśam ekam pramucyate

original: N1.187c/ evaṃ sa bandhanāt tasmān mucyate niyutāḥ samāḥ //

original: N3.11c/ yādṛcchike tu saṃyājye tattyāge nāsti kilbiṣam //
analyzed: yādṛcchike tu saṃyājye tad tyāge na asti kilbiṣam

original: N3.12a/ śulkasthānaṃ vaṇik prāptaḥ śulkaṃ dadyād yathopagam /
analyzed: śulkasthānam vaṇij prāptaḥ śulkam dadyāt yathā upagam

original: N3.12c/ na tad vyatihared rājñāṃ balir eṣa prakalpitaḥ //
analyzed: na tat vyatiharet rājñām baliḥ eṣa prakalpitaḥ

original: N3.13a/ śulkasthānaṃ pariharan na kāle krayavikrayī /
analyzed: śulkasthānam pariharan na kāle krayavikrayī

original: N3.13c/ mithyoktvā ca parīmāṇaṃ dāpyo 'aṣṭaguṇam atyayam //
analyzed: mithyā uktvā ca parīmāṇam dāpyaḥ aṣṭaguṇam atyayam

original: N3.14a/ kaścic cet saṃcaran deśāt preyād abhyāgato vaṇik /
analyzed: kaścid ced saṃcaran deśāt preyāt abhyāgataḥ vaṇij

original: N3.14c/ rājāsya bhāṇḍaṃ tad rakṣet yāvad dāyādadarśanam //
analyzed: rājā asya bhāṇḍam tat rakṣet yāvat dāyāda darśanam

original: N3.15a/ dāyāde 'asati bandhubhyo jñātibhyo vā tad arpayet /
analyzed: dāyāde asati bandhubhyaḥ jñātibhyaḥ vā tat arpayet

original: N3.15c/ tadabhāve suguptaṃ tad dhārayed daśatīḥ samāḥ //
analyzed: tad abhāve su guptam tat dhārayet daśatīḥ samāḥ

original: N3.16a/ asvāmikam adāyādaṃ daśavarṣasthitaṃ tataḥ /
analyzed: a svāmikam a dāyādam daśa varṣa sthitam tatas

original: N3.16c/ rājā tad ātmasāt kuryād evaṃ dharmo na hīyate //
analyzed: rājā tat ātmasāt kuryāt evam dharmaḥ na hīyate

original: 4.dattāpradānikam
analyzed: datta apradānikam

original: N4.01a/ dattvā dravyam asamyag yaḥ punar ādātum icchati /
analyzed: dattvā dravyam asamyak yaḥ punar ādātum icchati

original: N4.01c/ dattāpradānikaṃ nāma tad vivādapadaṃ smṛtam //
analyzed: dattāpradānikam nāma tat vivāda padam smṛtam

original: N4.02a/ adeyam atha deyaṃ ca dattaṃ cādattam eva ca /
analyzed: adeyam atha deyam ca dattam ca adattam eva ca

original: N4.02c/ vyavahāreṣu vijñeyo dānamārgaś caturvidhaḥ //
analyzed: vyavahāreṣu vijñeyaḥ dāna mārgaḥ caturvidhaḥ

original: N4.03a/ tatra hyaṣṭāv adeyāni deyam ekavidhaṃ smṛtam /
analyzed: tatra hi aṣṭa adeyāni deyam ekavidham smṛtam

original: N4.03c/ dattaṃ saptavidhaṃ vidyād adattaṃ ṣoḍaśātmakam //
analyzed: dattam saptavidham vidyāt adattam ṣoḍaśa ātmakam

original: N4.04a/ anvāhitaṃ yācitakam ādhiḥ sādhāraṇaṃ ca yat /
analyzed: anvāhitam yācitakam ādhiḥ sādhāraṇam ca yat

original: N4.04c/ nikṣepaḥ putradāraṃ ca sarvasvaṃ cānvaye sati //
analyzed: nikṣepaḥ putra dāram ca sarva svam ca anvaye sati

original: N4.05a/ āpatsv api hi kaṣṭāsu vartamānena dehinā /
analyzed: āpatsu api hi kaṣṭāsu vartamānena dehinā

original: N4.05c/ adeyāny āhur ācāryā yac cānyasmai pratiśrutam //
analyzed: adeyāni āhuḥ ācāryāḥ yat ca anyasmai pratiśrutam

original: N4.06a/ kuṭumbabharaṇād dravyaṃ yatkiṃcid atiricyate /
analyzed: kuṭumba bharaṇāt dravyam yat kiṃcid atiricyate

original: N4.06c/ tad deyam upahṛtyānyad dadad doṣam avāpnuyāt //
analyzed: tat deyam upahṛtya anyat dadat doṣam avāpnuyāt

original: N4.07a/ paṇyamūlyaṃ bhṛtis tuṣṭyā snehāt pratyupakārataḥ /
analyzed: paṇya mūlyam bhṛtiḥ tuṣṭyā snehāt pratyupakārataḥ

original: N4.07c/ strīśulkānugrahārthaṃ ca dattaṃ dānavido viduḥ //
analyzed: strī śulka anugraha artham ca dattam dāna vidaḥ viduḥ

original: N4.08a/ adattaṃ tu bhayakrodhaśokavegarujānvitaiḥ /
analyzed: adattam tu bhaya krodha śoka vega rujā anvitaiḥ

original: N4.08c/ tathotkocaparīhāsavyatyāsacchalayogataḥ //
analyzed: tathā utkoca parīhāsa vyatyāsa chala yogāt

original: N4.09a/ bālamūḍhāsvatantrārtamattonmattāpavarjitam /
analyzed: bāla mūḍha asvatantra ārta matta unmatta apavarjitam

original: N4.09c/ kartā mamāyaṃ karmeti pratilābhecchayā ca yat //
analyzed: kartā mama ayam karma iti pratilābha icchayā ca yat

original: N4.10a/ apātre pātram ity ukte kārye cādharmasaṃhite /
analyzed: apātre pātram iti ukte kārye ca adharma saṃhite

original: N4.10c/ yad dattaṃ syād avijñānād adattaṃ tad api smṛtam //
analyzed: yat dattam syāt avijñānāt adattam tat api smṛtam

original: N4.11a/ gṛhṇāty adattaṃ yo lobhād yaś cādeyaṃ prayacchati /
analyzed: gṛhṇāti adattam yaḥ lobhāt yaḥ ca adeyam prayacchati

original: N4.11c/ adattādāyako daṇḍyas tathādeyasya dāyakaḥ //
analyzed: adatta ādāyakaḥ daṇḍyaḥ tathā adeyasya dāyakaḥ

original: 5.abhyupetyāśuśrūṣā
analyzed: abhyupetya śuśrūṣā

original: N5.01a/ abhyupetya tu śuśrūṣāṃ yas tāṃ na pratipadyate /
analyzed: abhyupetya tu śuśrūṣām yaḥ tām na pratipadyate

original: N5.01c/ aśuśrūṣābhyupetyaitad vivādapadam ucyate //
analyzed: a śuśrūṣā abhyupetya etat vivāda padam ucyate

original: N5.02a/ śuśrūṣakaḥ pañcavidhaḥ śāstre dṛṣṭo manīṣibhiḥ /
analyzed: śuśrūṣakaḥ pañcavidhaḥ śāstre dṛṣṭaḥ manīṣibhiḥ

original: N5.02c/ caturvidhaḥ karmakaras teṣāṃ dāsās tripañcakāḥ //
analyzed: caturvidhaḥ karmakaraḥ teṣām dāsāḥ tripañcakāḥ

original: N5.03a/ śiṣyāntevāsibhṛtakāś caturthas tv adhikarmakṛt /
analyzed: śiṣya antevāsi bhṛtakāḥ caturthaḥ tu adhikarma kṛt

original: N5.03c/ ete karmakarāḥ proktā dāsās tu gṛhajādayaḥ //
analyzed: ete karmakarāḥ proktāḥ dāsāḥ tu gṛha ja ādayaḥ

original: N5.04a/ sāmānyam asvatantratvam eṣām āhur manīṣiṇaḥ /
analyzed: sāmānyam asvatantra tvam eṣām āhuḥ manīṣiṇaḥ

original: N5.04c/ jātikarmakṛtas tūkto viśeṣo vṛttir eva ca //
analyzed: jāti karma kṛtaḥ tu uktaḥ viśeṣaḥ vṛttiḥ eva ca

original: N5.05a/ karmāpi dvividhaṃ jñeyam aśubhaṃ śubham eva ca /
analyzed: karma api dvividham jñeyam aśubham śubham eva ca

original: N5.05c/ aśubhaṃ dāsakarmoktaṃ śubhaṃ karmakṛtāṃ smṛtam //
analyzed: aśubham dāsa karma uktam śubham karma kṛtām smṛtam

original: N5.06a/ gṛhadvārāśucisthānarathyāvaskaraśodhanam /
analyzed: gṛha dvāra aśuci sthāna rathyā avaskara śodhanam

original: N5.06c/ guhyāṅgasparśanocchiṣṭaviṇmūtragrahaṇojjhanam //
analyzed: guhya aṅga sparśana ucchiṣṭa viṣ mūtra grahaṇa ujjhanam

original: N5.07a/ iṣṭataḥ svāminaś cāṅgair upasthānam athāntataḥ /
analyzed: iṣṭatas svāminaḥ ca aṅgaiḥ upasthānam atha antatas

original: N5.07c/ aśubhaṃ karma vijñeyaṃ śubham anyad ataḥ param //
analyzed: aśubham karma vijñeyam śubham anyat atas param

original: N5.08a/ ā vidyāgrahaṇāc chiṣyaḥ śuśrūṣet prayato gurum /
analyzed: ā vidyā grahaṇāt śiṣyaḥ śuśrūṣet prayataḥ gurum

original: N5.08c/ tadvṛttir gurudāreṣu guruputre tathaiva ca //
analyzed: tad vṛttiḥ guru dāreṣu guru putre tathā eva ca

original: N5.09a/ brahmacārī cared bhaikṣam adhaḥśāyy analaṅkṛtaḥ /
analyzed: brahmacārī caret bhaikṣam adhas śāyī an alaṅkṛtaḥ

original: N5.09c/ jaghanyaśāyī sarveṣāṃ pūrvotthāyī guror gṛhe //
analyzed: jaghanya śāyī sarveṣām pūrva utthāyī guroḥ gṛhe

original: N5.10a/ nāsaṃdiṣṭaḥ pratiṣṭheta tiṣṭhed vāpi guruṃ kvacit /
analyzed: na a saṃdiṣṭaḥ pratiṣṭheta tiṣṭhet vā api gurum kvacid

original: N5.10c/ saṃdiṣṭaḥ karma kurvīta śaktaś ced avicārayan //
analyzed: saṃdiṣṭaḥ karma kurvīta śaktaḥ ced a vicārayan

original: N5.11a/ yathākālam adhīyīta yāvan na vimanā guruḥ /
analyzed: yathākālam adhīyīta yāvat na vimanāḥ guruḥ

original: N5.11c/ āsīno 'adho guroḥ kūrce phalake vā samāhitaḥ //
analyzed: āsīnaḥ adhas guroḥ kūrce phalake vā samāhitaḥ

original: N5.12a/ anuśāsyaś ca guruṇā na ced anuvidhīyate /
analyzed: anuśāsyaḥ ca guruṇā na ced anuvidhīyate

original: N5.12c/ avadhenāthavā hanyāt rajjvā veṇudalena vā //
analyzed: avadhena athavā hanyāt rajjvā veṇu dalena vā

original: N5.13a/ bhṛśaṃ na tāḍayed enaṃ nottamāṅge na vakṣasi /
analyzed: bhṛśam na tāḍayet enam na uttamāṅge na vakṣasi

original: N5.13c/ anuśāsyātha viśvāsyaḥ śāsyo rājñānyathā guruḥ //
analyzed: anuśāsya atha viśvāsyaḥ śāsyaḥ rājñā anyathā guruḥ

original: N5.14a/ samāvṛttaś ca gurave pradāya gurudakṣiṇām /
analyzed: samāvṛttaḥ ca gurave pradāya guru dakṣiṇām

original: N5.14c/ pratīyāt svagṛhān eṣā śiṣyavṛttir udāhṛtā //
analyzed: pratīyāt sva gṛhān eṣā śiṣya vṛttiḥ udāhṛtā

original: N5.15a/ svaśilpam icchann āhartuṃ bāndhavānām anujñayā /
analyzed: sva śilpam icchan āhartum bāndhavānām anujñayā

original: N5.15c/ ācāryasya vased ante kālaṃ kṛtvā suniścitam //
analyzed: ācāryasya vaset ante kālam kṛtvā su niścitam

original: N5.16a/ ācāryaḥ śikṣayed enaṃ svagṛhād dattabhojanam /
analyzed: ācāryaḥ śikṣayet enam sva gṛhāt datta bhojanam

original: N5.16c/ na cānyat kārayet karma putravac cainam ācaret //
analyzed: na ca anyat kārayet karma putra vat ca enam ācaret

original: N5.17a/ śikṣayantam aduṣṭaṃ ca yas tv ācāryaṃ parityajet /
analyzed: śikṣayantam aduṣṭam ca yaḥ tu ācāryam parityajet

original: N5.17c/ balād vāsayitavyaḥ syād vadhabandhau ca so 'arhati //
analyzed: balāt vāsayitavyaḥ syāt vadha bandhau ca saḥ arhati

original: N5.18a/ śikṣito 'api kṛtaṃ kālam antevāsī samāpnuyāt /
analyzed: śikṣitaḥ api kṛtam kālam antevāsī samāpnuyāt

original: N5.18c/ tatra karma ca yat kuryād ācāryasyaiva tatphalam //
analyzed: tatra karma ca yat kuryāt ācāryasya eva tat phalam

original: N5.19a/ gṛhītaśilpaḥ samaye kṛtvācāryaṃ pradakṣiṇam /
analyzed: gṛhīta śilpaḥ samaye kṛtvā ācāryam pradakṣiṇam

original: N5.19c/ śaktitaś cānumānyainam antevāsī nivartayet //
analyzed: śaktitas ca anumānya enam antevāsī nivartayet

original: N5.20a/ bhṛtakas trividho jñeya uttamo madhyamo 'adhamaḥ /
analyzed: bhṛtakaḥ trividhaḥ jñeyaḥ uttamaḥ madhyamaḥ adhamaḥ

original: N5.20c/ śaktibhaktyanurūpā syād eṣāṃ karmāśrayā bhṛtiḥ //
analyzed: śakti bhakti anurūpā syāt eṣām karma āśrayā bhṛtiḥ

original: N5.21a/ uttamas tv āyudhīyo 'atra madhyamas tu kṛṣīvalaḥ /
analyzed: uttamaḥ tu āyudhīyaḥ atra madhyamaḥ tu kṛṣīvalaḥ

original: N5.21c/ adhamo bhāravāhaḥ syād ity evaṃ trividho bhṛtaḥ //
analyzed: adhamaḥ bhāra vāhaḥ syāt iti evam trividhaḥ bhṛtaḥ

original: N5.22a/ artheṣv adhikṛto yaḥ syāt kuṭumbasya tathopari /
analyzed: artheṣu adhikṛtaḥ yaḥ syāt kuṭumbasya tathā upari

original: N5.22c/ so 'adhikarmakaro jñeyaḥ sa ca kauṭumbikaḥ smṛtaḥ //
analyzed: saḥ adhikarmakaraḥ jñeyaḥ sa ca kauṭumbikaḥ smṛtaḥ

original: N5.23a/ śubhakarmakarās tv ete catvāraḥ samudāhṛtāḥ /
analyzed: śubha karma karāḥ tu ete catvāraḥ samudāhṛtāḥ

original: N5.23c/ jaghanyakarmabhājas tu śeṣā dāsās tripañcakāḥ //
analyzed: jaghanya karma bhājaḥ tu śeṣāḥ dāsāḥ tri pañcakāḥ

original: N5.24a/ gṛhajātas tathā krīto labdho dāyād upāgataḥ /
analyzed: gṛha jātaḥ tathā krītaḥ labdhaḥ dāyāt upāgataḥ

original: N5.24c/ anākālabhṛtas tadvad ādhattaḥ svāminā ca yaḥ //
analyzed: an ākālabhṛtaḥ tadvat ādhattaḥ svāminā ca yaḥ

original: N5.25a/ mokṣito mahataś carṇāt prāpto yuddhāt paṇe jitaḥ /
analyzed: mokṣitaḥ mahataḥ ca ṛṇāt prāptaḥ yuddhāt paṇe jitaḥ

original: N5.25c/ tavāham ity upagataḥ pravrajyāvasitaḥ kṛtaḥ //
analyzed: tava aham iti upagataḥ pravrajyā avasitaḥ kṛtaḥ

original: N5.26a/ bhaktadāsaś ca vijñeyas tathaiva vaḍavābhṛtaḥ /
analyzed: bhaktadāsaḥ ca vijñeyaḥ tathā eva vaḍavābhṛtaḥ

original: N5.26c/ vikretā cātmanaḥ śāstre dāsāḥ pañcadaśā smṛtāḥ //
analyzed: vikretā ca ātmanaḥ śāstre dāsāḥ pañcadaśā smṛtāḥ

original: N5.27a/ tatra pūrvaś caturvargo dāsatvān na vimucyate /
analyzed: tatra pūrvaḥ caturvargaḥ dāsa tvāt na vimucyate

original: N5.27c/ prasādād svāmino 'anyatra dāsyam eṣāṃ kramāgatam //
analyzed: prasādāt svāminaḥ anyatra dāsyam eṣām krama āgatam

original: N5.28a/ yaś caiṣāṃ svāminaṃ kaścin mokṣayet prāṇasaṃśayāt /
analyzed: yaḥ ca eṣām svāminam kaścid mokṣayet prāṇa saṃśayāt

original: N5.28c/ dāsatvāt sa vimucyeta putrabhāgaṃ labheta ca //
analyzed: dāsa tvāt sa vimucyeta putra bhāgam labheta ca

original: N5.29a/ anākālabhṛto dāsyān mucyate goyugaṃ dadat /
analyzed: an ākālabhṛtaḥ dāsyāt mucyate go yugam dadat

original: N5.29c/ saṃbhakṣitaṃ yad durbhikṣe na tac chudhyeta karmaṇā //
analyzed: saṃbhakṣitam yat durbhikṣe na tat śudhyeta karmaṇā

original: N5.30a/ ādhatto 'api dhanaṃ dattvā svāmī yady enam uddharet /
analyzed: ādhattaḥ api dhanam dattvā svāmī yadi enam uddharet

original: N5.30c/ athopagamayed enaṃ sa vikrītād anantaraḥ //
analyzed: atha upagamayet enam sa vikrītāt anantaraḥ

original: N5.31a/ dattvā tu sodayam ṛṇaṃ ṛṇī dāsyāt pramucyate /
analyzed: dattvā tu sa udayam ṛṇam ṛṇī dāsyāt pramucyate

original: N5.31c/ kṛtakālābhyupagamāt kṛtako 'api vimucyate //
analyzed: kṛta kāla abhyupagamāt kṛtakaḥ api vimucyate

original: N5.32a/ tavāham ity upagato yuddhaprāptaḥ paṇe jitaḥ /
analyzed: tava aham iti upagataḥ yuddha prāptaḥ paṇe jitaḥ

original: N5.32c/ pratiśīrṣapradānena mucyate tulyakarmaṇā //
analyzed: prati śīrṣa pradānena mucyate tulya karmaṇā

original: N5.33a/ rājña eva tu dāsaḥ syāt pravrajyāvasito naraḥ /
analyzed: rājñaḥ eva tu dāsaḥ syāt pravrajyā avasitaḥ naraḥ

original: N5.33c/ na tasya pratimokṣo 'asti na viśuddhiḥ kathaṃcana //
analyzed: na tasya pratimokṣaḥ asti na viśuddhiḥ kathaṃcana

original: N5.34a/ bhaktasyopekṣaṇāt sadyo bhaktadāsaḥ pramucyate /
analyzed: bhaktasya upekṣaṇāt sadyas bhakta dāsaḥ pramucyate

original: N5.34c/ nigrahād vaḍavāyāś ca mucyate vaḍavābhṛtaḥ //
analyzed: nigrahāt vaḍavāyāḥ ca mucyate vaḍabābhṛtaḥ

original: N5.35a/ vikrīṇīte ya ātmānaṃ svatantraḥ san narādhamaḥ /
analyzed: vikrīṇīte yaḥ ātmānam svatantraḥ san nara adhamaḥ

original: N5.35c/ sa jaghanyataras teṣāṃ naiva dāsyāt pramucyate //
analyzed: sa jaghanyataraḥ teṣām na eva dāsyāt pramucyate

original: N5.36a/ caurāpahṛtavikrītā ye ca dāsīkṛtā balāt /
analyzed: caura apahṛta vikrītāḥ ye ca dāsīkṛtāḥ balāt

original: N5.36c/ rājñā mokṣayitavyās te dāsatvaṃ teṣu neṣyate //
analyzed: rājñā mokṣayitavyāḥ te dāsa tvam teṣu na iṣyate

original: N5.37a/ varṇānāṃ prātilomyena dāsatvaṃ na vidhīyate /
analyzed: varṇānām prātilomyena dāsa tvam na vidhīyate

original: N5.37c/ svadharmatyāgino 'anyatra dāravad dāsatā matā //
analyzed: svadharma tyāginaḥ anyatra dāra vat dāsa tā matā

original: N5.38a/ tavāham iti cātmānaṃ yo 'asvatantraḥ prayacchati /
analyzed: tava aham iti ca ātmānam yaḥ asvatantraḥ prayacchati

original: N5.38c/ na sa taṃ prāpnuyāt kāmaṃ pūrvasvāmī labheta tam //
analyzed: na sa tam prāpnuyāt kāmam pūrva svāmī labheta tam

original: N5.39a/ adhanās traya evoktā bhāryā dāsas tathā sutaḥ /
analyzed: adhanāḥ trayaḥ eva uktāḥ bhāryā dāsaḥ tathā sutaḥ

original: N5.39c/ yat te samadhigacchanti yasya te tasya tad dhanam //
analyzed: yat te samadhigacchanti yasya te tasya tat dhanam

original: N5.40a/ svadāsam icched yaḥ kartum adāsaṃ prītamānasaḥ /
analyzed: sva dāsam icchet yaḥ kartum adāsam prīta mānasaḥ

original: N5.40c/ skandhād ādāya tasyāpi bhindyāt kumbhaṃ sahāmbhasā //
analyzed: skandhāt ādāya tasya api bhindyāt kumbham saha ambhasā

original: N5.41a/ akṣatābhiḥ sapuṣpābhir mūrdhany enam avākiret /
analyzed: akṣatābhiḥ sa puṣpābhiḥ mūrdhani enam avākiret

original: N5.41c/ adāsa iti coktvā triḥ prāṅmukhaṃ tam athotsṛjet //
analyzed: adāsaḥ iti ca uktvā tris prāc mukham tam atha utsṛjet

original: N5.42a/ tataḥprabhṛti vaktavyaḥ svāmyanugrahapālitaḥ /
