analyzed: dve bhārye kṣatriyasya anye vaiśyasya ekā prakīrtitā

original: N12.6c/ vaiśyāyā dvau patī jñeyāv eko 'anyaḥ kṣatriyāpatiḥ //
analyzed: vaiśyāyāḥ dvau patī jñeyau ekaḥ anyaḥ kṣatriyā patiḥ

original: N12.7a/ ā saptamāt pañcamād vā bandhubhyaḥ pitṛmātṛtāḥ /
analyzed: ā saptamāt pañcamāt vā bandhubhyaḥ

original: N12.7c/ avivāhyāḥ sagotrāḥ syuḥ samānapravarās tathā //
analyzed: avivāhyāḥ sagotrāḥ syuḥ samāna pravarāḥ tathā

original: N12.8a/ parīkṣyaḥ puruṣaḥ puṃstve nijair evāṅgalakṣaṇaiḥ /
analyzed: parīkṣyaḥ puruṣaḥ puṃstve nijaiḥ eva aṅga lakṣaṇaiḥ

original: N12.8c/ pumāṃś ced avikalpena sa kanyāṃ labdhum arhati //
analyzed: pumān ced avikalpena sa kanyām labdhum arhati

original: N12.9a/ subaddhajatrujānvasthiḥ subaddhāṃsaśirodharaḥ /
analyzed: su baddha jatru jānu asthiḥ su baddha aṃsa śirodharaḥ

original: N12.9c/ sthūlaghāṭas tanūrutvag avilagnagatisvaraḥ //
analyzed: sthūla ghāṭaḥ tanu ūru tvac avilagna gati svaraḥ

original: N12.10a/ viṭ cāsya plavate nāpsu hlādi mūtraṃ ca phenilam /
analyzed: viṣ ca asya plavate na apsu hlādi mūtram ca phenilam

original: N12.10c/ pumān syāṃl lakṣaṇair etair viparītais tu paṇḍakaḥ //
analyzed: pumān syan lakṣaṇaiḥ etaiḥ viparītaiḥ tu paṇḍakaḥ

original: N12.11a/ caturdaśavidhaḥ śāstre sa tu dṛṣṭo manīṣibhiḥ /
analyzed: caturdaśavidhaḥ śāstre sa tu dṛṣṭaḥ manīṣibhiḥ

original: N12.11c/ cikitsyaś cācikitsyaś ca teṣām ukto vidhiḥ kramāt //
analyzed: cikitsyaḥ ca acikitsyaḥ ca teṣām uktaḥ vidhiḥ kramāt

original: N12.12a/ nisargapaṇḍo vadhriś ca pakṣapaṇḍas tathaiva ca /
analyzed: nisarga paṇḍaḥ vadhriḥ ca pakṣapaṇḍaḥ tathā eva ca

original: N12.12c/ abhiśāpād guro rogād devakrodhāt tathaiva ca //
analyzed: abhiśāpāt guroḥ rogāt deva krodhāt tathā eva ca

original: N12.13a/ īrṣyāpaṇḍaś ca sevyaś ca vātaretā mukhebhagaḥ /
analyzed: īrṣyāpaṇḍaḥ ca sevyaḥ ca vātaretāḥ mukhebhagaḥ

original: N12.13c/ ākṣipto moghabījaś ca śālīno 'anyapatis tathā //
analyzed: ākṣiptaḥ moghabījaḥ ca śālīnaḥ anya patiḥ tathā

original: N12.14a/ tatrādyāv apratīkarau pakṣākhyo māsam ācaret /
analyzed: tatra ādyau apratīkarau pakṣa ākhyaḥ māsam ācaret

original: N12.14c/ anukramāt trayasyāsya kālaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ smṛtaḥ //
analyzed: anukramāt trayasya asya kālaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ smṛtaḥ

original: N12.15a/ īrṣyāpaṇḍādayo ye 'anye catvāraḥ samudāhṛtāḥ /
analyzed: īrṣyāpaṇḍa ādayaḥ ye anye catvāraḥ samudāhṛtāḥ

original: N12.15c/ saṃtyaktavyāḥ patitavat kṣatayonyā api striyāḥ //
analyzed: saṃtyaktavyāḥ patita vat kṣata yonyāḥ api striyāḥ

original: N12.16a/ ākṣiptamoghabījābhyām patyāv apratikarmaṇi /
analyzed: ākṣipta moghabījābhyām patau apratikarmaṇi

original: N12.16c/ patir anyaḥ smṛto nāryā vatsaraṃ saṃpratīkṣya tu //
analyzed: patiḥ anyaḥ smṛtaḥ nāryāḥ vatsaram saṃpratīkṣya tu

original: N12.17a/ śālīnasyāpi dhṛṣṭastrīsaṃyogād bhajyate dhvajaḥ /
analyzed: śālīnasya api dhṛṣṭa strī saṃyogāt bhajyate dhvajaḥ

original: N12.17c/ taṃ hīnavegam anyastrībālādyābhir upakramet //
analyzed: tam hīna vegam anya strī bāla ādyābhiḥ upakramet

original: N12.18a/ anyasyām yo manuṣyaḥ syād amanuṣyaḥ svayoṣiti /
analyzed: anyasyām yaḥ manuṣyaḥ syāt amanuṣyaḥ sva yoṣiti

original: N12.18c/ labheta sānyaṃ bhartāram etat kāryaṃ prajāpateḥ //
analyzed: labheta sā anyam bhartāram etat kāryam prajāpateḥ

original: N12.19a/ apatyārthaṃ striyaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ strī kṣetraṃ bījinaḥ prajāḥ /
analyzed: apatya artham striyaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ strī kṣetram bījinaḥ prajāḥ

original: N12.19c/ kṣetraṃ bījavate deyaṃ nābījī kṣetram arhati //
analyzed: kṣetram bījavate deyam na abījī kṣetram arhati

original: N12.20a/ pitā dadyāt svayaṃ kanyām bhrātā vānumate pituḥ /
analyzed: pitā dadyāt svayam kanyām bhrātā vā anumate pituḥ

original: N12.20c/ mātāmaho mātulaś ca sakulyā bāndhavās tathā //
analyzed: mātāmahaḥ mātulaḥ ca sakulyāḥ bāndhavāḥ tathā

original: N12.21a/ mātābhāve tu sarveṣāṃ prakṛtau yadi vartate /
analyzed: mātā abhāve tu sarveṣām prakṛtau yadi vartate

original: N12.21c/ tasyām aprakṛtisthāyāṃ dadyuḥ kanyāṃ svajātayaḥ //
analyzed: tasyām aprakṛti sthāyām dadyuḥ kanyām sva jātayaḥ

original: N12.22a/ yadā tu naiva kaścit syāt kanyā rājānam āvrajet /
analyzed: yadā tu na eva kaścid syāt kanyā rājānam āvrajet

original: N12.22c/ anujñayā tasya varaṃ pratītya varayet svayam //
analyzed: anujñayā tasya varam pratītya varayet svayam

original: N12.23a/ savarṇam anurūpaṃ ca kularūpavayaḥśrutaiḥ /
analyzed: savarṇam anurūpam ca kula rūpa vayaḥ śrutaiḥ

original: N12.23c/ saha dharmaṃ caret tena putrāṃś cotpādayet tataḥ //
analyzed: saha dharmam caret tena putrān ca utpādayet tatas

original: N12.24a/ pratigṛhya ca yaḥ kanyāṃ naro deśāntaraṃ vrajet /
analyzed: pratigṛhya ca yaḥ kanyām naraḥ deśa antaram vrajet

original: N12.24c/ trīn ṛtūn samatikramya kanyānyaṃ varayed varam //
analyzed: trīn ṛtūn samatikramya kanyā anyam varayet varam

original: N12.25a/ kanyā nartum upekṣeta bāndhavebhyo nivedayet /
analyzed: kanyā na ṛtum upekṣeta bāndhavebhyaḥ nivedayet

original: N12.25c/ te cen na dadyus tāṃ bhartre te syur bhrūṇahabhiḥ samāḥ //
analyzed: te ced na dadyuḥ tām bhartre te syuḥ bhrūṇa habhiḥ samāḥ

original: N12.26a/ yāvantaś ca rtavas tasyāḥ samatītā patiṃ vinā /
analyzed: yāvantaḥ ca ṛtavaḥ tasyāḥ samatītā patim vinā

original: N12.26c/ tāvatyo bhrūṇahatyāḥ syus tasya yo na dadāti tām //
analyzed: tāvatyaḥ bhrūṇa hatyāḥ syuḥ tasya yaḥ na dadāti tām

original: N12.27a/ ato 'apravṛtte rajasi kanyāṃ dadyāt pitā sakṛt /
analyzed: atas apravṛtte rajasi kanyām dadyāt pitā sakṛt

original: N12.27c/ mahad enaḥ spṛśed enam anyathaiṣa vidhiḥ satām //
analyzed: mahat enaḥ spṛśet enam anyathā eṣa vidhiḥ satām

original: N12.28a/ sakṛd aṃśo nipatati sakṛt kanyā pradīyate /
analyzed: sakṛt aṃśaḥ nipatati sakṛt kanyā pradīyate

original: N12.28c/ sakṛd āha dadānīti trīṇy etāni sakṛt sakṛt //
analyzed: sakṛt āha dadāni iti trīṇi etāni sakṛt sakṛt

original: N12.29a/ brāhmādiṣu vivāheṣu pañcasv eṣu vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ /
analyzed: brāhma ādiṣu vivāheṣu pañcasu eṣu vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ

original: N12.29c/ guṇāpekṣaṃ bhaved dānam āsurādiṣu ca triṣu //
analyzed: guṇa apekṣam bhavet dānam āsura ādiṣu ca triṣu

original: N12.30a/ kanyāyām prāptaśulkāyāṃ jyāyāṃś ced vara āvrajet /
analyzed: kanyāyām prāpta śulkāyām jyāyāḥ ced varaḥ āvrajet

original: N12.30c/ dharmārthakāmasaṃyuktaṃ vācyaṃ tatrānṛtaṃ bhavet //
analyzed: dharma artha kāma saṃyuktam vācyam tatra anṛtam bhavet

original: N12.31a/ nāduṣṭāṃ dūṣayet kanyāṃ nāduṣṭaṃ dūṣayed varam /
analyzed: na aduṣṭām dūṣayet kanyām na aduṣṭam dūṣayet varam

original: N12.31c/ doṣe tu sati nāgaḥ syād anyonyaṃ tyajatos tayoḥ //
analyzed: doṣe tu sati na āgaḥ syāt anyonyam tyajatoḥ tayoḥ

original: N12.32a/ dattvā nyāyena yaḥ kanyāṃ varāya na dadāti tām /
analyzed: dattvā nyāyena yaḥ kanyām varāya na dadāti tām

original: N12.32c/ aduṣṭaś ced varo rājñā sa daṇḍyas tatra coravat //
analyzed: aduṣṭaḥ ced varaḥ rājñā sa daṇḍyaḥ tatra cora vat

original: N12.33a/ yas tu doṣavatīṃ kanyām anākhyāya prayacchati /
analyzed: yaḥ tu doṣavatīm kanyām an ākhyāya prayacchati

original: N12.33c/ tasya kuryān nṛpo daṇḍaṃ pūrvasāhasacoditam //
analyzed: tasya kuryāt nṛpaḥ daṇḍam pūrvasāhasa coditam

original: N12.34a/ akanyeti tu yaḥ kanyāṃ brūyād dveṣeṇa mānavaḥ /
analyzed: akanyā iti tu yaḥ kanyām brūyāt dveṣeṇa mānavaḥ

original: N12.34c/ sa śataṃ prāpnuyād daṇḍaṃ tasyā doṣam adarśayan //
analyzed: sa śatam prāpnuyāt daṇḍam tasyāḥ doṣam a darśayan

original: N12.35a/ pratigṛhya tu yaḥ kanyām aduṣṭām utsṛjed varaḥ /
analyzed: pratigṛhya tu yaḥ kanyām aduṣṭām utsṛjet varaḥ

original: N12.35c/ vineyaḥ so 'apy akāmo 'api kanyāṃ tām eva codvahet //
analyzed: vineyaḥ saḥ api akāmaḥ api kanyām tām eva ca udvahet

original: N12.36a/ dīrghakutsitarogārtā vyaṅgā  saṃsṛṣṭamaithunā /
analyzed: dīrgha kutsita roga ārtā vyaṅgā saṃsṛṣṭa maithunā

original: N12.36c/ dhṛṣṭānyagatabhāvā ca kanyādoṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
analyzed: dhṛṣṭā anya gata bhāvā ca kanyā doṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ

original: N12.37a/ unmattaḥ patitaḥ klībo durbhagas tyaktabāndhavaḥ /
analyzed: unmattaḥ patitaḥ klībaḥ durbhagaḥ tyakta bāndhavaḥ

original: N12.37c/ kanyādoṣau ca yau pūrvau eṣa doṣagaṇo vare //
analyzed: kanyā doṣau ca yau pūrvau eṣa doṣa gaṇaḥ vare

original: N12.38a/ aṣṭau vivāhā varṇānāṃ saṃskārārthaṃ prakīrtitāḥ /
analyzed: aṣṭau vivāhāḥ varṇānām saṃskāra artham prakīrtitāḥ

original: N12.38c/ brāhmas tu prathamas teṣāṃ prājāpatyas tathaiva ca //
analyzed: brāhmaḥ tu prathamaḥ teṣām prājāpatyaḥ tathā eva ca

original: N12.39a/ ārṣaś caivātha daivaś ca gāndharvaś cāsuras tathā /
analyzed: ārṣaḥ ca eva atha daivaḥ ca gāndharvaḥ ca āsuraḥ tathā

original: N12.39c/ rākṣaso 'anantaras tasmāt paiśācas tv aṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ //
analyzed: rākṣasaḥ anantaraḥ tasmāt paiśācaḥ tu aṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ

original: N12.40a/ satkṛtyāhūya kanyāṃ tu brāhme dadyād tv alaṃkṛtām /
analyzed: satkṛtya āhūya kanyām tu brāhme dadyāt tu alaṃkṛtām

original: N12.40c/ saha dharmaṃ carety uktvā prājāpatyo vidhīyate //
analyzed: saha dharmam cara iti uktvā prājāpatyaḥ vidhīyate

original: N12.41a/ vastragomithune dattvā vivāhas tv ārṣa ucyate /
analyzed: vastra go mithune dattvā vivāhaḥ tu ārṣaḥ ucyate

original: N12.41c/ antarvedyāṃ tu daivaḥ syād ṛtvije karma kurvate //
analyzed: antarvedyām tu daivaḥ syāt ṛtvije karma kurvate

original: N12.42a/ icchantīm icchate prāhur gāndharvo nāma pañcamam /
analyzed: icchantīm icchate prāhuḥ gāndharvaḥ nāma pañcamam

original: N12.42c/ vivāhas tv āsuro jñeyaḥ śulkasaṃvyavahārataḥ //
analyzed: vivāhaḥ tu āsuraḥ jñeyaḥ śulka saṃvyavahārāt

original: N12.43a/ prasahya haraṇād ukto vivāho rākṣasas tathā /
analyzed: prasahya haraṇāt uktaḥ vivāhaḥ rākṣasaḥ tathā

original: N12.43c/ suptamattopagamanāt paiśācas tv aṣṭamo 'adhamaḥ //
analyzed: supta matta upagamanāt paiśācaḥ tu aṣṭamaḥ adhamaḥ

original: N12.44a/ eṣāṃ tu dharmyās catvāro brāhmādyāḥ samudāhṛtāḥ /
analyzed: eṣām tu dharmyāḥ catvāraḥ brāhma ādyāḥ samudāhṛtāḥ

original: N12.44c/ sādhāraṇaḥ syād gāndharvas trayo 'adharmyās tv ataḥ pare //
analyzed: sādhāraṇaḥ syāt gāndharvaḥ trayaḥ adharmyāḥ tu atas pare

original: N12.45a/ parapūrvāḥ striyas tv anyāḥ sapta proktā yathākramam /
analyzed: parapūrvāḥ striyaḥ tu anyāḥ sapta proktāḥ yathākramam

original: N12.45c/ punarbhūs trividhā tāsāṃ svairiṇī tu caturvidhā //
analyzed: punarbhūḥ trividhā tāsām svairiṇī tu caturvidhā

original: N12.46a/ kanyaivākṣatayonir yā pāṇigrahaṇadūṣitā /
analyzed: kanyā eva akṣatayoniḥ yā pāṇigrahaṇa dūṣitā

original: N12.46c/ punarbhūḥ prathamā soktā punaḥ saṃskāram arhati //
analyzed: punarbhūḥ prathamā sā uktā punar saṃskāram arhati

original: N12.47a/ kaumāraṃ patim utsṛjya yānyaṃ puruṣam āśritā /
analyzed: kaumāram patim utsṛjya yā anyam puruṣam āśritā

original: N12.47c/ punaḥ patyur gṛham yāyāt sā dvitīyā prakīrtitā //
analyzed: punar pateḥ gṛham yāyāt sā dvitīyā prakīrtitā

original: N12.48a/ asatsu devareṣu strī bāndhavair yā pradīyate /
analyzed: asatsu devareṣu strī bāndhavaiḥ yā pradīyate

original: N12.48c/ savarṇāyāsapiṇḍāya sā tṛtīyā prakīrtitā //
analyzed: savarṇāya asapiṇḍāya sā tṛtīyā prakīrtitā

original: N12.49a/ strī prasūtāprasūtā vā patyāv eva tu jīvati /
analyzed: strī prasūtā a prasūtā vā patau eva tu jīvati

original: N12.49c/ kāmāt samāśrayed anyaṃ prathamā svairiṇī tu sā //
analyzed: kāmāt samāśrayet anyam prathamā svairiṇī tu sā

original: N12.50a/ mṛte bhartari yā prāptān devarān apy apāsya tu /
analyzed: mṛte bhartri yā prāptān devarān api apāsya tu

original: N12.50c/ upagacchet paraṃ kāmāt sā dvitīyā prakīrtitā //
analyzed: upagacchet param kāmāt sā dvitīyā prakīrtitā

original: N12.51a/ prāptā deśād dhanakrītā kṣutpipāsāturā ca yā  /
analyzed: prāptā deśāt dhana krītā kṣudh pipāsā āturā ca yā

original: N12.51c/ tavāham ity upagatā sā tṛtīyā prakīrtitā //
analyzed: tava aham iti upagatā sā tṛtīyā prakīrtitā

original: N12.52a/ deśadharmān apekṣya strī gurubhir yā pradīyate /
analyzed: deśa dharmān apekṣya strī gurubhiḥ yā pradīyate

original: N12.52c/ utpannasāhasānyasmai sāntyā vai svairiṇī smṛtā //
analyzed: utpanna sāhasā anyasmai sā antyā vai svairiṇī smṛtā

original: N12.53a/ punarbhuvāṃ eṣa vidhiḥ svairiṇīnāṃ ca kīrtitaḥ /
analyzed: punarbhuvām eṣa vidhiḥ svairiṇīnām ca kīrtitaḥ

original: N12.53c/ pūrvā pūrvājaghanyāsāṃ śreyasī tūttarottarā //
analyzed: pūrvā pūrvā jaghanyā āsām śreyāḥ tu uttarottarā

original: N12.54a/ apatyam utpādayitus tāsāṃ yā śulkato hṛtā /
analyzed: apatyam utpādayituḥ tāsām yā śulkataḥ hṛtā

original: N12.54c/ aśulkopanatāyāṃ tu kṣetrikasyaiva tat phalam //
analyzed: a śulka upanatāyām tu kṣetrikasya eva tat phalam

original: N12.55a/ kṣetrikasya yad ajñātaṃ kṣetre bījaṃ pradīyate /
analyzed: kṣetrikasya yat ajñātam kṣetre bījam pradīyate

original: N12.55c/ na tatra bījino bhāgaḥ kṣetrikasyaiva tad bhavet //
analyzed: na tatra bījinaḥ bhāgaḥ kṣetrikasya eva tat bhavet

original: N12.56a/ oghavātāhṛtaṃ bījaṃ kṣetre yasya prarohati /
analyzed: ogha vāta āhṛtam bījam kṣetre yasya prarohati

original: N12.56c/ phalabhug yasya tat kṣetraṃ na bījī phalabhāg bhavet //
analyzed: phala bhuj yasya tat kṣetram na bījī phala bhāj bhavet

original: N12.57a/ mahokṣo janayed vatsān yasya goṣu vraje caran /
analyzed: mahā ukṣaḥ janayet vatsān yasya goṣu vraje caran

original: N12.57c/ tasya te yasya tā gāvo moghaṃ syanditam ārṣabham //
analyzed: tasya te yasya tāḥ gāvaḥ mogham syanditam ārṣabham

original: N12.58a/ kṣetrikānumataṃ bījaṃ yasya kṣetre pramucyate /
analyzed: kṣetrika anumatam bījam yasya kṣetre pramucyate

original: N12.58c/ tadapatyaṃ dvayor eva bījikṣetrikayor matam //
analyzed: tad apatyam dvayoḥ eva bīji kṣetrikayoḥ matam

original: N12.59a/ narte kṣetraṃ bhavet sasyaṃ na ca bījaṃ vināsti tat /
analyzed: na ṛte kṣetram bhavet sasyam na ca bījam vinā asti tat

original: N12.59c/ ato 'apatyaṃ dvayor iṣṭaṃ pitur mātuś ca dharmataḥ //
analyzed: atas apatyam dvayoḥ iṣṭam pituḥ mātuḥ ca dharmataḥ

original: N12.60a/ nāthavatyā paragṛhe saṃyuktasya striyā saha /
analyzed: nāthavatyā para gṛhe saṃyuktasya striyā saha

original: N12.60c/ dṛṣṭaṃ saṃgrahaṇaṃ tajjñair nāgatāyāḥ svayaṃ gṛhe //
analyzed: dṛṣṭam saṃgrahaṇam tad jñaiḥ na āgatāyāḥ svayam gṛhe

original: N12.61a/ praduṣṭatyaktadārasya klībasya kṣamakasya ca /
analyzed: praduṣṭa tyakta dārasya klībasya kṣamakasya ca

original: N12.61c/ svecchayopeyuṣo dārān na doṣaḥ sāhaso bhavet //
analyzed: sva icchayā upeyivasaḥ dārān na doṣaḥ sāhasaḥ bhavet

original: N12.62a/ parastriyā sahākāle 'adeśe vā bhavato mithaḥ /
analyzed: para striyā saha akāle adeśe vā bhavataḥ mithas

original: N12.62c/ sthānasaṃbhāṣaṇāmodās trayaḥ saṃgrahaṇakramāḥ //
analyzed: sthāna saṃbhāṣaṇa āmodāḥ trayaḥ saṃgrahaṇa kramāḥ

analyzed: te eva tasya draṣṭāraḥ syuḥ te eva ca sākṣiṇaḥ

original: N17.5a/ aśuddhaḥ kitavo nānyad āśrayed dyūtamaṇḍalam /
analyzed: aśuddhaḥ kitavaḥ na anyat āśrayet dyūta maṇḍalam

original: N17.5c/ pratihanyān na sabhikaṃ dāpayet tat svam iṣṭataḥ //
analyzed: pratihanyāt na sabhikam dāpayet tat svam iṣṭatas

original: N17.6a/ kūṭākṣadevinaḥ pāpān nirbhajed dyūtamaṇḍalāt /
analyzed: kūṭa akṣa devinaḥ pāpān nirbhajet dyūta maṇḍalāt

original: N17.6c/ kaṇṭhe 'akṣamālām āsajya sa hy eṣāṃ vinayaḥ smṛtaḥ //
analyzed: kaṇṭhe akṣamālām āsajya sa hi eṣām vinayaḥ smṛtaḥ

original: 18.prakīrṇakam
analyzed: prakīrṇakam

original: N18.1a/ prakīrṇake punar jñeyā vyavahārā nṛpāśrayāḥ /
analyzed: prakīrṇake punar jñeyāḥ vyavahārāḥ nṛpa āśrayāḥ

original: N18.1c/ rājñām ājñāpratīghātas tatkarmakaraṇaṃ tathā //
analyzed: rājñām ājñā pratīghātaḥ tad karma karaṇam tathā

original: N18.2a/ purapradānaṃ saṃbhedaḥ prakṛtīnāṃ tathaiva ca /
analyzed: pura pradānam saṃbhedaḥ prakṛtīnām tathā eva ca

original: N18.2c/ pāṣaṇḍanaigamaśreṇīgaṇadharmaviparyayāḥ //
analyzed: pāṣaṇḍa naigama śreṇi gaṇa dharma viparyayāḥ

original: N18.3a/ pitṛputravivādaś ca prāyaścittavyatikramaḥ /
analyzed: pitṛ putra vivādaḥ ca prāyaścitta vyatikramaḥ

original: N18.3c/ pratigrahavilopaś ca kopa āśramiṇām api //
analyzed: pratigraha vilopaḥ ca kopaḥ āśramiṇām api

original: N18.4a/ varṇasaṃkaradoṣaś ca tadvṛttiniyamas tathā /
analyzed: varṇa saṃkara doṣaḥ ca tad vṛtti niyamaḥ tathā

original: N18.4c/ na dṛṣṭaṃ yac ca pūrveṣu tat sarvaṃ syāt prakīrṇake //
analyzed: na dṛṣṭam yat ca pūrveṣu tat sarvam syāt prakīrṇake

original: N18.5a/ rājā tv avahitaḥ sarvān āśramān paripālayet /
analyzed: rājā tu avahitaḥ sarvān āśramān paripālayet

original: N18.5c/ upāyaiḥ śāstravihitaiś caturbhiḥ prakṛtais tathā //
analyzed: upāyaiḥ śāstra vihitaiḥ caturbhiḥ prakṛtaiḥ tathā

original: N18.6a/ yo yo varṇo 'avahīyeta yo vodrekam anuvrajet /
analyzed: yaḥ yaḥ varṇaḥ avahīyeta yaḥ vā udrekam anuvrajet

original: N18.6c/ taṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā svato mārgāt pracyutaṃ sthāpayet pathi //
analyzed: tam tam dṛṣṭvā svatas mārgāt pracyutam sthāpayet pathini

original: N18.7a/ aśāstrokteṣu cānyeṣu pāpayukteṣu karmasu /
analyzed: a śāstra ukteṣu ca anyeṣu pāpa yukteṣu karmasu

original: N18.7c/ prasamīkṣyātmano rājā daṇḍaṃ daṇḍyeṣu pātayet //
analyzed: prasamīkṣya ātmanaḥ rājā daṇḍam daṇḍyeṣu pātayet

original: N18.8a/ śrutismṛtiviruddhaṃ ca janānām ahitaṃ ca yat /
analyzed: śruti smṛti viruddham ca janānām ahitam ca yat

original: N18.8c/ na tat pravartayed rājā pravṛttaṃ ca nivartayet //
analyzed: na tat pravartayet rājā pravṛttam ca nivartayet

original: N18.9a/ nyāyāpetaṃ yad anyena rājñājñānakṛtaṃ ca yat /
analyzed: nyāya apetam yat anyena rājñā ajñāna kṛtam ca yat

original: N18.9c/ tad apy anyāyavihitaṃ punar nyāye niveśayet //
analyzed: tat api anyāya vihitam punar nyāye niveśayet

original: N18.10a/ rājñā pravartitān dharmānyo naro nānupālayet /
analyzed: rājñā pravartitān dharmān yaḥ naraḥ na anupālayet

original: N18.10c/ daṇḍyaḥ sa pāpo vadhyaś ca lopayan rājaśāsanam //
analyzed: daṇḍyaḥ sa pāpaḥ vadhyaḥ ca lopayan rāja śāsanam

original: N18.11a/ āyudhāny āyudhīyānāṃ vāhyādīn vāhyajīvinām /
analyzed: āyudhāni āyudhīyānām vāhya ādīn vāhya jīvinām

original: N18.11c/ veśyāstrīṇām alaṃkāraṃ vādyātodyāni tadvidām //
analyzed: veśyā strīṇām alaṃkāram vādya ātodyāni tad vidām

original: N18.12a/ yac ca yasyopakaraṇaṃ yena jīvanti kārukāḥ /
analyzed: yat ca yasya upakaraṇam yena jīvanti kārukāḥ

original: N18.12c/ sarvasvaharaṇe 'apy etān na rājā hartum arhati //
analyzed: sarva sva haraṇe api etān na rājā hartum arhati

original: N18.13a/ anādiś cāpy anantaś ca dvipadāṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ /
analyzed: anādiḥ ca api anantaḥ ca dvipadām pṛthivīpatiḥ

original: N18.13c/ dīptimatvāc chucitvāc ca yadi na syāt pathaś cyutaḥ //
analyzed: dīptimat tvāt śuci tvāt ca yadi na syāt pathaḥ cyutaḥ

original: N18.14a/ yadi rājā na sarveṣāṃ varṇānāṃ daṇḍadhāraṇam /
analyzed: yadi rājā na sarveṣām varṇānām daṇḍadhāraṇam

original: N18.14c/ kuryāt patho vyapetānāṃ vinaśyeyur imāḥ prajāḥ //
analyzed: kuryāt pathaḥ vyapetānām vinaśyeyuḥ imāḥ prajāḥ

original: N18.15a/ brāhmaṇyaṃ brāhmaṇo jahyāt kṣatriyaḥ kṣātram utsṛjet /
analyzed: brāhmaṇyam brāhmaṇaḥ jahyāt kṣatriyaḥ kṣātram utsṛjet

original: N18.15c/ svakarma jahyād vaiśyas tu śūdraḥ sarvān viśeṣayet //
analyzed: sva karma jahyāt vaiśyaḥ tu śūdraḥ sarvān viśeṣayet

original: N18.16a/ rājānaś cen nābhaviṣyan pṛthivyāṃ daṇḍadhāraṇam /
analyzed: rājānaḥ ced na abhaviṣyan pṛthivyām daṇḍadhāraṇam

original: N18.16c/ śūle matsyān ivāpakṣyan durbalān balavattarāḥ //
analyzed: śūle matsyān iva apakṣyan durbalān balavattarāḥ

original: N18.17a/ satām anugraho nityam asatāṃ nigrahas tathā /
analyzed: satām anugrahaḥ nityam asatām nigrahaḥ tathā

original: N18.17c/ eṣa dharmaḥ smṛto rājñām arthaś cāmitrapīḍanāt //
analyzed: eṣa dharmaḥ smṛtaḥ rājñām arthaḥ ca amitra pīḍanāt

original: N18.18a/ na lipyate yathā vahnir dahañ chaśvad imāḥ prajāḥ /
analyzed: na lipyate yathā vahniḥ dahan śaśvat imāḥ prajāḥ

original: N18.18c/ na lipyate tathā rājā daṇḍaṃ daṇḍyeṣu pātayan //
analyzed: na lipyate tathā rājā daṇḍam daṇḍyeṣu pātayan

original: N18.19a/ ājñā tejaḥ pārthivānāṃ sā ca vāci pratiṣṭhitā /
analyzed: ājñā tejaḥ pārthivānām sā ca vāci pratiṣṭhitā

original: N18.19c/ te yad brūyur asat sad vā sa dharmo vyavahāriṇām //
analyzed: te yat brūyuḥ asat sat vā sa dharmaḥ vyavahāriṇām

original: N18.20a/ rājā nāma caraty eṣa bhūmau sākṣāt sahasradṛk /
analyzed: rājā nāma carati eṣa bhūmau sākṣāt sahasradṛś

original: N18.20c/ na tasyājñām atikramya saṃtiṣṭheran prajāḥ kvacit //
analyzed: na tasya ājñām atikramya saṃtiṣṭheran prajāḥ kvacid

original: N18.21a/ rakṣādhikārād īśatvād bhūtānugrahadarśanāt /
analyzed: rakṣā adhikārāt īśa tvāt bhūta anugraha darśanāt

original: N18.21c/ yad eva rājā kurute tat pramāṇam iti sthitiḥ //
analyzed: yat eva rājā kurute tat pramāṇam iti sthitiḥ

original: N18.22a/ nirguṇo 'api yathā strīṇāṃ pūjya eva patiḥ sadā /
analyzed: nirguṇaḥ api yathā strīṇām pūjyaḥ eva patiḥ sadā

original: N18.22c/ prajānāṃ viguṇo 'apy evaṃ pūjya eva narādhipaḥ //
analyzed: prajānām viguṇaḥ api evam pūjyaḥ eva narādhipaḥ

original: N18.23a/ tapaḥkrītāḥ prajā rājñā prabhur āsāṃ tato nṛpaḥ /
analyzed: tapaḥ krītāḥ prajāḥ rājñā prabhuḥ āsām tatas nṛpaḥ

original: N18.23c/ tatas tadvacasi stheyaṃ vārtā cāsāṃ tadāśrayā //
analyzed: tatas tad vacasi stheyam vārttā ca āsām tad āśrayā

original: N18.24a/ pañca rūpāṇi rājāno dhārayanty amitaujasaḥ /
analyzed: pañca rūpāṇi rājānaḥ dhārayanti amita ojasaḥ

original: N18.24c/ agner indrasya somasya yamasya dhanadasya ca //
analyzed: agneḥ indrasya somasya yamasya dhanadasya ca

original: N18.25a/ kāraṇād animittaṃ vā yadā krodhavaśaṃ gataḥ /
analyzed: kāraṇāt animittam vā yadā krodha vaśam gataḥ

original: N18.25c/ prajā dahati bhūpālas tadāgnir abhidhīyate //
analyzed: prajāḥ dahati bhūpālaḥ tadā agniḥ abhidhīyate

original: N18.26a/ yadā tejaḥ samālambya vijigīṣur udāyudhaḥ /
analyzed: yadā tejaḥ samālambya vijigīṣuḥ udāyudhaḥ

original: N18.26c/ abhiyāti parān rājā tadendraḥ sa udāhṛtaḥ //
analyzed: abhiyāti parān rājā tadā indraḥ saḥ udāhṛtaḥ

original: N18.27a/ vigatakrodhasaṃtāpo hṛṣṭarūpo yadā nṛpaḥ /
analyzed: vigata krodha saṃtāpaḥ hṛṣṭa rūpaḥ yadā nṛpaḥ

original: N18.27c/ prajānāṃ darśanaṃ yāti soma ity ucyate tadā //
analyzed: prajānām darśanam yāti somaḥ iti ucyate tadā

original: N18.28a/ dharmāsanagataḥ śrīmān daṇḍaṃ dhatte yadā nṛpaḥ /
analyzed: dharma āsana gataḥ śrīmān daṇḍam dhatte yadā nṛpaḥ

original: N18.28c/ samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu tadā vaivasvataḥ yamaḥ //
analyzed: samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu tadā vaivasvataḥ yamaḥ

original: N18.29a/ yadā tv arthiguruprājñabhṛtyādīn avanīpatiḥ /
analyzed: yadā tu arthi guru prājña bhṛtya ādīn avanīpatiḥ

original: N18.29c/ anugṛhṇāti dānena tadā sa dhanadaḥ smṛtaḥ //
analyzed: anugṛhṇāti dānena tadā sa dhanadaḥ smṛtaḥ

original: N18.30a/ tasmāt taṃ nāvajānīyān nākrośen na viśeṣayet /
analyzed: tasmāt tam na avajānīyāt na ākrośet na viśeṣayet

original: N18.30c/ ājñāyāṃ cāsya tiṣṭheta mṛtyuḥ syāt tadvyatikramāt //
analyzed: ājñāyām ca asya tiṣṭheta mṛtyuḥ syāt tad vyatikramāt

original: N18.31a/ tasya vṛttiḥ prajārakṣā vṛddhaprājñopasevanam /
analyzed: tasya vṛttiḥ prajā rakṣā vṛddha prājña upasevanam

original: N18.31c/ darśanaṃ vyavahārāṇām ātmanaś cābhirakṣaṇam //
analyzed: darśanam vyavahārāṇām ātmanaḥ ca abhirakṣaṇam

original: N18.32a/ brāhmaṇān upaseveta nityaṃ rājā samāhitaḥ /
analyzed: brāhmaṇān upaseveta nityam rājā samāhitaḥ

original: N18.32c/ saṃyuktaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatraṃ mūlaṃ lokābhirakṣaṇe //
analyzed: saṃyuktam brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatram mūlam loka abhirakṣaṇe

original: N18.33a/ brāhmaṇasyāparīhāro rājanyāsanam agrataḥ /
analyzed: brāhmaṇasya aparīhāraḥ rājñi āsanam agratas

original: N18.33c/ prathamaṃ darśanaṃ prātaḥ sarvebhyaś cābhivādanam //
analyzed: prathamam darśanam prātar sarvebhyaḥ ca abhivādanam

original: N18.34a/ agraṃ navebhyaḥ sasyebhyo mārgadānaṃ ca gacchataḥ /
analyzed: agram navebhyaḥ sasyebhyaḥ mārga dānam ca gacchataḥ

original: N18.34c/ bhaikṣahetoḥ parāgāre praveśas tv anivāritaḥ //
analyzed: bhaikṣa hetoḥ para āgāre praveśaḥ tu anivāritaḥ

original: N18.35a/ samitpuṣpodakādāneṣv asteyaṃ saparigrahāt /
analyzed: samidh puṣpa udaka ādāneṣu asteyam sa parigrahāt

original: N18.35c/ anākṣepaḥ parebhyaś ca saṃbhāṣaś ca parastriyā //
analyzed: anākṣepaḥ parebhyaḥ ca saṃbhāṣaḥ ca para striyā

original: N18.36a/ nadīṣv avetanas tāraḥ pūrvam uttaraṇaṃ tathā /
analyzed: nadīṣu a vetanaḥ tāraḥ pūrvam uttaraṇam tathā

original: N18.36c/ tareṣv aśulkadānaṃ ca na ced vāṇijyam asya tat //
analyzed: tareṣu a śulka dānam ca na ced vāṇijyam asya tat

original: N18.37a/ vartamāno 'adhvani śrānto gṛhṇann anivasan svayam /
analyzed: vartamānaḥ adhvani śrāntaḥ gṛhṇan a nivasan svayam

original: N18.37c/ brāhmaṇo nāparādhnoti dvāv ikṣū pañca mūlakān //
analyzed: brāhmaṇaḥ na aparādhnoti dvau ikṣū pañca mūlakān

original: N18.38a/ nābhiśastān na patitān na dviṣo na ca nāstikāt /
analyzed: na abhiśastāt na patitāt na dviṣaḥ na ca nāstikāt

original: N18.38c/ na sopadhān nānimittaṃ na dātāraṃ prapīḍya ca //
analyzed: na sa upadhāt na animittam na dātāram prapīḍya ca

original: N18.39a/ arthānāṃ bhūribhāvāc ca deyatvāc ca mahātmanām /
analyzed: arthānām bhūri bhāvāt ca deya tvāt ca mahātmanām

original: N18.39c/ śreyān pratigraho rājñāṃ anyeṣāṃ brāhmaṇād ṛte //
analyzed: śreyān pratigrahaḥ rājñām anyeṣām brāhmaṇāt ṛte

original: N18.40a/ brāhmaṇaś caiva rājā ca dvāv apy etau dhṛtavratau /
analyzed: brāhmaṇaḥ ca eva rājā ca dvau api etau dhṛta vratau

original: N18.40c/ naitayor antaraṃ kiṃcit prajādharmābhirakṣaṇāt //
analyzed: na etayoḥ antaram kiṃcid prajā dharma abhirakṣaṇāt

original: N18.41a/ dharmajñasya kṛtajñasya rakṣārthaṃ śāsato 'aśucīn /
analyzed: dharma jñasya kṛtajñasya rakṣā artham śāsataḥ aśucīn

original: N18.41c/ medhyam eva dhanaṃ prāhus tīkṣṇasyāpi mahīpateḥ //
analyzed: medhyam eva dhanam prāhuḥ tīkṣṇasya api mahīpateḥ

original: N18.42a/ śucīnām aśucīnāṃ ca saṃnipāto yathāmbhasām /
analyzed: śucīnām aśucīnām ca saṃnipātaḥ yathā ambhasām

original: N18.42c/ samudre samatāṃ yāti tadvad rājño dhanāgamaḥ //
analyzed: samudre sama tām yāti tadvat rājñaḥ dhana āgamaḥ

original: N18.43a/ yathā cāgnau sthitaṃ dīpte śuddhim āyāti kāñcanam /
analyzed: yathā ca agnau sthitam dīpte śuddhim āyāti kāñcanam

original: N18.43c/ evam evāgamā sarve śuddhim āyānti rājasu //
analyzed: evam sarve śuddhim āyānti rājsu

original: N18.44a/ ya eva kaścit svadravyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati /
analyzed: yaḥ eva kaścid sva dravyam brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati

original: N18.44c/ tad rājñāpy anumantavyam eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ //
analyzed: tat rājñā api anumantavyam eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ

original: N18.45a/ anyaprakārād ucitād bhūmeḥ ṣaḍbhāgasaṃjñitāt /
analyzed: anya prakārāt ucitāt bhūmeḥ ṣaṣ bhāga saṃjñitāt

original: N18.45c/ baliḥ sa tasya vihitaḥ prajāpālanavetanam //
analyzed: baliḥ sa tasya vihitaḥ prajā pālana vetanam

original: N18.46a/ śakyaṃ tat punar ādātuṃ yad abrāhmaṇasātkṛtam /
analyzed: śakyam tat punar ādātum yat a brāhmaṇasāt kṛtam

original: N18.46c/ brāhmaṇāya tu yad dattaṃ na tasya haraṇaṃ punaḥ //
analyzed: brāhmaṇāya tu yat dattam na tasya haraṇam punar

original: N18.47a/ dānam adhyayanaṃ yajñas tasya karma trilakṣaṇam /
analyzed: dānam adhyayanam yajñaḥ tasya karma tri lakṣaṇam

original: N18.47c/ yājanādhyāpane vṛttis tṛtīyas tu pratigrahaḥ //
analyzed: yājana adhyāpane vṛttiḥ tṛtīyaḥ tu pratigrahaḥ

original: N18.48a/ svakarmaṇi dvijas tiṣṭhed vṛttim āhārayet kṛtām /
analyzed: sva karmaṇi dvijaḥ tiṣṭhet vṛttim āhārayet kṛtām

original: N18.48c/ nāsadbhyaḥ pratigṛhṇīyād varṇebhyo niyame 'asati //
analyzed: na asadbhyaḥ pratigṛhṇīyāt varṇebhyaḥ niyame asati

original: N18.49a/ aśucir vacanād yasya śucir bhavati puruṣaḥ /
analyzed: aśuciḥ vacanāt yasya śuciḥ bhavati puruṣaḥ

original: N18.49c/ śuciś caivāśuciḥ sadyaḥ kathaṃ rājā na daivatam //
analyzed: śuciḥ ca eva aśuciḥ sadyas katham rājā na daivatam

original: N18.50a/ vidur ya eva devatvaṃ rājño hy amitatejasaḥ /
analyzed: viduḥ ye eva deva tvam rājñaḥ hi amita tejasaḥ

original: N18.50c/ tasya te pratigṛhṇanto na lipyante dvijātayaḥ //
analyzed: tasya te pratigṛhṇantaḥ na lipyante dvijātayaḥ

original: N18.51a/ loke 'asmin maṅgalāny aṣṭau brāhmaṇo gaur hutāśanaḥ /
analyzed: loke asmin maṅgalāni aṣṭau brāhmaṇaḥ gauḥ hutāśanaḥ

original: N18.51c/ hiraṇyaṃ sarpir āditya āpo rājā tathāṣṭamaḥ //
analyzed: hiraṇyam sarpiḥ ādityaḥ apaḥ rājā tathā aṣṭamaḥ

original: N18.52a/ etāni satataṃ paśyen namasyed arcayec ca tān /
analyzed: etāni satatam paśyet namasyet arcayet ca tān

original: N18.52c/ pradakṣiṇaṃ ca kurvīta tathā hy āyur na hīyate //
analyzed: pradakṣiṇam ca kurvīta tathā hi āyuḥ na hīyate

original: pariśiṣṭam
analyzed: pariśiṣṭam

original: 19.steyam
analyzed: steyam

original: N19.1a/ dvividhās taskarā jñeyāḥ paradravyāpahāriṇaḥ /
analyzed: dvividhāḥ taskarāḥ jñeyāḥ para dravya apahāriṇaḥ

original: N19.1c/ prakāśāś cāprakāśāś ca tān vidyād ātmavān nṛpaḥ //
analyzed: prakāśāḥ ca aprakāśāḥ ca tān vidyāt ātmavān nṛpaḥ
